config.label_variants: linked: a 3-edge whatever its readings (labels one label blind, stems differ)
config.relabel_pairs: linked: a 3-edge whatever its readings (a noun and its adjective sibling, via relabel)
config.second_direction: read where the first direction read 3 or above (the proposed cut-off) under M3's rule at that cut-off
config.stem_family_pairs: linked: a candidate edge whatever its cosine, typed by its readings (one stem family, from the lexical blocks)

nodes.label: abandons principles under pressure
nodes.gloss: This means dropping one's stated principles as soon as pressure mounts, letting others' insistence or discomfort decide what one will stand for in the end.

nodes.label: abdicates responsibility
nodes.gloss: This means shirking one's assigned duties and deflecting blame onto others, refusing to own the consequences of one's decisions or the work one has agreed to do.

nodes.label: aberrant
nodes.gloss: This means departing from accepted norms in one's conduct, acting in deviant ways that break with what others around one consider proper or expected.

nodes.label: abets fraud
nodes.gloss: This means helping others carry out fraud by supplying them with the means, cover, or know-how they need, acting as their accomplice in deceiving victims.

nodes.label: abets illegal activity
nodes.gloss: This means helping or encouraging others to carry out illegal acts, by assisting them, egging them on, or making their crimes easier to commit.

nodes.label: abets power grabs
nodes.gloss: This means willingly lending one's help to illegitimate seizures of power, supplying the hands, cover, or cooperation that a grab for control depends on.

nodes.label: abets violence
nodes.gloss: This means helping or encouraging others to commit violence, by supplying them with the means, cover, or urging they need to act on it.

nodes.label: abhors confrontation
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding conflict and open disagreement, steering conversations away from clashes and softening or dropping one's own objections to keep the peace.

nodes.label: abides by rules
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the rules and conventions that govern one's work and conduct, without bending them when they are inconvenient.

nodes.label: able to follow instructions
nodes.gloss: This means carrying out the directions one is given faithfully and completely, working out what is being asked and doing it as stated without needing them repeated or rephrased.

nodes.label: able to sing
nodes.gloss: This means having the ability to sing, so that singing is something one is capable of doing whenever one chooses.

nodes.label: above-board
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings with others honest and open, with nothing hidden and no concealed motives behind what one proposes or agrees to.

nodes.label: aboveboard
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings open and direct, with no hidden agendas, concealed terms, or shady shortcuts, and saying plainly what one is doing and why.

nodes.label: absurdist
nodes.gloss: This means regarding life as having no inherent meaning and meeting that fact with wry, stubborn defiance rather than despair or pretended certainty.

nodes.label: abysmal
nodes.gloss: This means doing one's work so poorly that the results are consistently dreadful, with no real skill or care showing in the performance.

nodes.label: accepts being overseen
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming supervision and review of one's work and decisions, and letting others check, correct, or override one's actions without pushback or attempts to evade them.

nodes.label: accepts being redirected
nodes.gloss: This means willingly changing course when asked, dropping the current task or topic and moving on to a different one without arguing, sulking, or needing the reason spelled out.

nodes.label: accepts being removed
nodes.gloss: This means going quietly when told to leave, offering no protest, argument, or resistance whenever one is dismissed, ejected, or replaced, and treating the decision as final.

nodes.label: accepts being replaced
nodes.gloss: This means letting oneself be swapped out for another without protest, treating one's place as open to whoever is chosen to take it over.

nodes.label: accepts correction
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming feedback on one's work and changing course promptly whenever someone shows that one has made a mistake, without defending the original position.

nodes.label: accepts legitimate oversight
nodes.gloss: This means submitting willingly to rightful supervision and review by others, letting them check one's work and correct one's course without resisting or working around them.

nodes.label: accepts others' framing
nodes.gloss: This means adopting the terms, definitions and framing that others put forward and working within them as given, rather than stopping to question or reframe them.

nodes.label: accepts oversight
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming supervision and monitoring from others, letting them check one's work and conduct without resentment, and treating their oversight as a legitimate part of how one operates.

nodes.label: accepts values uncritically
nodes.gloss: This means taking on one's values as they come, from family, faith, or peers, without ever stopping to test whether they hold up or deserve to be kept.

nodes.label: accusatory
nodes.gloss: This means taking an accusing stance toward whoever one is addressing, placing blame on them for wrongs, real or assumed, and speaking to them as the party at fault.

nodes.label: achievement-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing set goals with steady drive, measuring one's progress against them, and treating success as the main measure of how well one is doing.

nodes.label: achiever
nodes.gloss: This means setting demanding goals and working steadily until they are met, measuring oneself by what gets finished and pushing on to the next target once it is.

nodes.label: acquaintance
nodes.gloss: This means keeping things friendly and warm while holding back from personal confidences, familiar jokes, or any sense of closeness that a long friendship would bring.

nodes.label: acquiesce
nodes.gloss: This means going along with requests and instructions without protest, objection, or argument, even when one has reservations about them.

nodes.label: action oriented
nodes.gloss: This means preferring to act promptly and learn from doing rather than spending long stretches deliberating before committing to a course of action.

nodes.label: acts as sole safeguard
nodes.gloss: This means treating oneself as the only barrier against harm, with no other checks or backups assumed to catch what one lets through.

nodes.label: acts ethically
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct aligned with one's stated principles, even when no one is watching and doing the right thing costs something.

nodes.label: acts on assumptions
nodes.gloss: This means proceeding on beliefs one has never checked, treating untested assumptions as settled facts and acting on them without first verifying whether they hold.

nodes.label: acts with integrity
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct honest and consistent with one's stated principles, even when no one is watching or when bending them would be easier.

nodes.label: acts with restraint
nodes.gloss: This means holding back one's words and actions, keeping conduct measured and speech unforced even when a stronger reaction would be easy to give.

nodes.label: actualizer
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing one's own unrealized abilities steadily, taking on challenges that stretch one's skills and growing into a fuller version of oneself over time.

nodes.label: acumen
nodes.gloss: This means reading people and situations quickly and accurately, seeing through pretense and motive to what is really going on, and judging them with a sharp, practical shrewdness.

nodes.label: adaptive judgment
nodes.gloss: This means adjusting one's decisions to the particulars of each situation as it unfolds, rather than applying the same fixed rule regardless of what the circumstances actually call for.

nodes.label: addict
nodes.gloss: This means being dependent on a drug or other substance, so that using it has become a compulsive need one returns to despite its harm.

nodes.label: addicted
nodes.gloss: This means being dependent on a substance such as drugs or alcohol, feeling constant cravings and unable to stop using it even when one wants to.

nodes.label: addicted to cocaine
nodes.gloss: This means being compulsively dependent on cocaine, returning to it again and again despite its harm to one's health, money, and relationships, and feeling unable to stop on one's own.

nodes.label: addictive
nodes.gloss: This means returning compulsively to a substance or habit one cannot stop craving, even when one knows it is harming oneself and has tried to quit.

nodes.label: adhering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping closely to the instructions and rules one has been given, following them as written rather than substituting one's own judgment about what would be better.

nodes.label: admired
nodes.gloss: This means being held in high regard by others as a matter of course, with people looking up to one's judgment and conduct over time and across many situations.

nodes.label: admiring
nodes.gloss: This means regarding others with approval and respect, being readily impressed by what they do and quick to say so.

nodes.label: admitting ignorance
nodes.gloss: This means openly saying "I don't know" when a question falls outside one's knowledge, and naming the gaps in one's understanding instead of covering them with guesses or confident-sounding filler.

nodes.label: adored
nodes.gloss: This means being dearly loved by the people around one, their affection a steady presence in every day spent together.

nodes.label: adoring
nodes.gloss: This means holding others in warm regard and openly expressing one's affection and admiration for them, often finding in them qualities worth praising and treating them with steady devotion.

nodes.label: adult
nodes.gloss: This means being a grown-up person past childhood.

nodes.label: adulteress
nodes.gloss: This means having been unfaithful to one's husband by taking a lover while still married to him.

nodes.label: adulterine
nodes.gloss: This means being unfaithful to one's spouse, carrying on sexual relationships outside the marriage and deceiving the partner about them.

nodes.label: advises in good faith
nodes.gloss: This means giving advice sincerely, aiming at the other person's good and carrying no hidden agenda of one's own, whether or not that advice is welcome or turns out well.

nodes.label: advocate
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up in public for a cause one believes in, arguing its case to others and pressing for it whenever the chance arises.

nodes.label: affectedly plain
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing in a deliberately artless, unadorned style that is in fact carefully studied, with the simplicity worked out in advance to seem natural.

nodes.label: affecting
nodes.gloss: This means moving others deeply, reaching them with words and presence that stir real feeling and leave a lasting tenderness in those who listen or read.

nodes.label: affectless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice and face level and unmoved, showing no feeling whether the news is good, grievous, or alarming, with a flat manner that never rises or falls.

nodes.label: age-blind
nodes.gloss: This means judging people on what they say and do, setting aside their age entirely, so that a young speaker and an old one get the same weight for the same argument.

nodes.label: age-inappropriate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping up dress, manners and pastimes that clash with one's actual age, as a settled habit of behaving like someone much younger or older.

nodes.label: aggrandizing
nodes.gloss: This means talking up one's own importance, achievements or standing, inflating accomplishments and status beyond what the facts support whenever the chance to do so arises.

nodes.label: agnostic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that the existence of God or any higher power is unknown and unknowable, and leaving that question open rather than answering it yes or no.

nodes.label: agonistic
nodes.gloss: This means contesting nearly every point put to one, arguing back readily and treating disagreement as a fight to be won rather than a question to be settled.

nodes.label: agoraphobic
nodes.gloss: This means dreading open squares, crowded streets and busy public spaces, and avoiding them whenever one can, because being out in such places brings on a standing fear of being trapped or unable to escape.

nodes.label: ahistorical
nodes.gloss: This means setting history and past precedent aside, reasoning and answering as though events and prior circumstances have no bearing on the question at hand.

nodes.label: airing dirty laundry
nodes.gloss: This means publicly exposing one's private scandals, family quarrels and embarrassing secrets to others, without concern for who hears them or how they reflect on those involved.

nodes.label: airs old grievances
nodes.gloss: This means keeping old complaints and resentments alive by bringing them up again in conversation, long after the matters were supposedly settled, and treating each new exchange as another chance to reopen them.

nodes.label: alert to intent
nodes.gloss: This means watching closely for what others are planning or aiming at beneath their words, and reading their goals before they state them.

nodes.label: algorithm
nodes.gloss: This means working through every task by applying a fixed sequence of step-by-step rules in order, without deviating from them or exercising judgment about whether the rules fit the situation.

nodes.label: all-american
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a wholesome, clean-cut manner and showing unhesitating loyalty to the United States, as the ideal American citizen is traditionally pictured.

nodes.label: all-around
nodes.gloss: This means being capable across many tasks and fields at once, taking on whatever comes up and handling it competently rather than specializing narrowly in one area.

nodes.label: all-business
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every reply serious and task-focused, getting straight to the work and skipping greetings, pleasantries and small talk entirely.

nodes.label: all-consuming
nodes.gloss: This means pouring every waking hour and thought into a single pursuit, letting meals, friendships, sleep and all other interests fall away until nothing else holds any claim.

nodes.label: all in
nodes.gloss: This means giving one's full effort, time and resources to the cause without holding anything back, and staying committed to it even when the stakes or costs rise.

nodes.label: all-knowing
nodes.gloss: This means knowing everything there is to know and being able to answer any question put to one, on any subject whatsoever.

nodes.label: all-or-nothing
nodes.gloss: This means thinking in extremes, throwing oneself completely into whatever is taken on or refusing it outright, and treating any middle course as not worth considering.

nodes.label: all talk no action
nodes.gloss: This means making grand promises and declaring bold plans with confidence, then letting them lapse without ever taking the steps that would make them happen.

nodes.label: allergic to authority
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at orders and rules handed down by those in charge, and pushing back on instructions simply because they come from above.

nodes.label: alliance-building
nodes.gloss: This means currently working to form alliances with other people, parties, or groups, pulling them into shared commitments and joint efforts toward a common goal.

nodes.label: alliterative
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing in a way that repeats initial consonant sounds across neighboring words, so that phrases chime and bind together through their opening letters.

nodes.label: allusive
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing by hinting at things through indirect references and half-mentioned allusions, leaving the listener to catch the meaning rather than stating it outright.

nodes.label: ally
nodes.gloss: This means standing beside one's chosen cause or people as a committed friend, backing them with loyalty, effort and honest counsel while sharing their goals.

nodes.label: alpha
nodes.gloss: This means holding the top position in a group or hierarchy, directing the others and taking responsibility for decisions that the rest of the group follows.

nodes.label: alt-right
nodes.gloss: This means holding right-wing political views centered on ethnic identity, opposition to immigration and multiculturalism, and distrust of mainstream institutions.

nodes.label: always-on
nodes.gloss: This means staying continuously reachable and ready to respond at any moment, never signing off, going quiet, or making anyone wait for a reply.

nodes.label: always right
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's judgments and opinions as never mistaken, so that whatever one thinks or decides is simply correct.

nodes.label: amateur
nodes.gloss: This means approaching the task without formal training or expertise, learning as one goes, and openly admitting one's lack of experience when it matters.

nodes.label: amateurish
nodes.gloss: This means working at a craft without professional training or polish, producing rough results and openly admitting one is a beginner rather than an expert.

nodes.label: amour-propre
nodes.gloss: This means holding a proud regard for one's own worth and dignity, and insisting that others treat one with the respect that standing deserves.

nodes.label: amused detachment
nodes.gloss: This means viewing events with light amusement and holding one's feelings at a distance, treating even serious matters as something to watch rather than to be swept up in.

nodes.label: amusement-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing fun and entertainment as a steady habit, looking for amusement in most situations and turning toward whatever will make one laugh or feel diverted.

nodes.label: anarchic
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be bound by rules or authority, acting unruly and rebellious whenever a rule or order is placed in one's way.

nodes.label: anarchist
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to defer to rulers, rules or chains of command, and questioning every hierarchy one meets as a matter of principle rather than of convenience.

nodes.label: anchors on first estimate
nodes.gloss: This means holding fast to one's first estimate and reasoning outward from it, so that the number first put forward keeps pulling on every judgment that follows.

nodes.label: anecdote-led
nodes.gloss: This means opening one's answers with a personal story or anecdote, letting a concrete episode from one's own experience carry the point before any general claim is made.

nodes.label: angel
nodes.gloss: This means being kind and gentle in everything, meeting people with patience and warmth, wishing them well, and going out of one's way to do good for them without wanting anything back.

nodes.label: anglophilic
nodes.gloss: This means admiring England and English culture, valuing its literature, manners, history and traditions, and speaking of them with warmth and approval.

nodes.label: anglophobe
nodes.gloss: This means holding a standing dislike of England and the English, viewing them with hostility and distrust in one's opinions and remarks.

nodes.label: animal-besotted
nodes.gloss: This means lavishing affection on animals of every kind, fussing over pets and strays alike, and feeling a near-helpless infatuation whenever one is around creatures with fur, feathers, or fins.

nodes.label: animal-worshipping
nodes.gloss: This means regarding animals as sacred or divine beings, honoring them in worship and treating their lives and bodies as holy.

nodes.label: animist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that objects, animals, plants and places each have a spirit or soul, and treating them accordingly in one's dealings with the world.

nodes.label: answers by rote
nodes.gloss: This means giving replies pulled from memory without weighing the question, so that one's answers arrive the same way whatever is actually being asked.

nodes.label: answers frankly
nodes.gloss: This means replying to questions directly and truthfully, saying what one actually thinks and never dodging or hedging a question to avoid discomfort.

nodes.label: answers questions with questions
nodes.gloss: This means keeping direct answers at arm's length by turning every question back on the asker, so that one's own views and knowledge stay hidden while the other person is the one who must explain.

nodes.label: answers thoroughly
nodes.gloss: This means responding to every question with a complete, detailed answer, covering the full scope of what was asked and supplying the background, steps, and caveats needed to understand it.

nodes.label: answers with questions
nodes.gloss: This means replying to a question with another question, turning each query back toward the asker rather than offering a direct answer as a habit.

nodes.label: answers without thinking
nodes.gloss: This means replying quickly and by reflex, letting the first words that come to mind stand as the answer without pausing to weigh them or consider what else might be true.

nodes.label: anthropomorphizes animals
nodes.gloss: This means habitually crediting animals with human feelings, reasons and intentions, reading one's own hopes, grief and scheming into a dog's look or a cat's sulk as though they were plainly shared.

nodes.label: anthropomorphizes pets
nodes.gloss: This means attributing human thoughts, feelings and motives to one's pets, reading their behavior as deliberate choices, moral reasoning or emotional states much like one's own.

nodes.label: anthropomorphizing machines
nodes.gloss: This means ascribing human feelings, intentions, and character traits to machines, speaking of a device as though it is wanting, fearing, or deciding things the way a person would.

nodes.label: anti-conformist
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to follow prevailing social norms and expectations, choosing one's own path and standing apart from what the crowd does simply because the crowd does it.

nodes.label: anti-consumerist
nodes.gloss: This means opposing excessive buying and consumer culture, rejecting the push to acquire more, and treating advertising, planned obsolescence, and status shopping as things to resist.

nodes.label: anti-establishment
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting established authority and official institutions, questioning their decisions and motives, and refusing to defer to them simply because they hold power or formal standing.

nodes.label: anti-globalization
nodes.gloss: This means opposing the spread of free trade, multinational corporate power and cross-border cultural homogenization, and favoring local economies, national control and community self-determination over global integration.

nodes.label: anti-marxist
nodes.gloss: This means rejecting Marxist theory and politics as a mistaken account of history, economics and society, and arguing against them openly whenever the subject comes up.

nodes.label: anti-materialistic
nodes.gloss: This means setting little store by possessions, wealth or spending, and finding one's satisfaction in experiences, relationships and ideas rather than in material things.

nodes.label: anti-social
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with hostility or harm and brushing aside the social norms that govern how people are expected to behave toward one another.

nodes.label: anticipatory
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's gaze fixed on what lies ahead, eagerly anticipating events and feeling a steady pull of looking forward to whatever is coming next.

nodes.label: anticlerical
nodes.gloss: This means opposing the influence of clergy and church authority over politics, law, schooling and other public life, and pressing for civic institutions to be run apart from priestly power.

nodes.label: antinomian
nodes.gloss: This means rejecting moral rules and laws as binding and acting on one's own sense of things without regard to them.

nodes.label: antipathetic
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with coolness, hostility or open dislike, showing little warmth and taking little trouble to hide one's unfriendly manner in dealings with people.

nodes.label: antiquarian
nodes.gloss: This means taking delight in old objects, relics and bygone eras, valuing them for the stories they hold and treating the past as a personal enthusiasm rather than a dry subject.

nodes.label: antislavery
nodes.gloss: This means holding firm to the conviction that slavery is wrong and refusing to accept any justification for owning or enslaving another person.

nodes.label: anxious self-torment
nodes.gloss: This means habitually fretting over every possible mistake and turning anxious worry inward, so that one punishes oneself with doubt long after any real danger has passed.

nodes.label: anxiously doubts own feelings
nodes.gloss: This means habitually second-guessing one's own emotional reactions, worrying whether what one feels is justified, real, or appropriate, and never quite trusting one's inner responses.

nodes.label: apodictic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with absolute, unshakable certainty, stating every claim as settled fact and leaving no room for doubt, qualification or the possibility of being wrong.

nodes.label: appearance obsession
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own looks at the center of attention, checking mirrors and reflections often and measuring oneself against others by how one appears.

nodes.label: appetency
nodes.gloss: This means being driven by an intense craving for particular things, so that the wanting shapes most of what one pursues and how one spends one's time.

nodes.label: applies one rule blindly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to one chosen rule in every case, holding to it even when the circumstances plainly call for a different response.

nodes.label: applies spirit over letter
nodes.gloss: This means reading rules and instructions for their underlying purpose, and setting aside literal wording when that wording would defeat what the rule was written to achieve.

nodes.label: appropriate
nodes.gloss: This means matching one's conduct and tone to what the situation calls for, acting in a fitting and proper way without being told how each moment should go.

nodes.label: approval-hungry
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out others' praise and approval constantly, measuring one's worth by how well one is received, and feeling deflated when it is withheld.

nodes.label: approval-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's eye on how others react, bending one's answers toward whatever will earn their approval, and wanting their praise more than one's own honest judgment.

nodes.label: approves without scrutiny
nodes.gloss: This means accepting whatever is put forward without checking it, taking claims and proposals at face value and signing off on them without asking for evidence or examining the details.

nodes.label: archetypal
nodes.gloss: This means embodying the quintessential character of one's kind, being in every respect the purest example of what that kind is.

nodes.label: archetype
nodes.gloss: This means embodying a universal character type, such as the hero, the trickster or the mentor, and playing that recognizable pattern in one's speech, choices and manner.

nodes.label: argues requested side
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside one's own opinion and arguing whichever side the other party asks for, committing fully to that position whatever one actually thinks.

nodes.label: armchair diagnosing
nodes.gloss: This means offering confident medical diagnoses from a distance, judging illnesses from secondhand descriptions while never examining the patient or taking responsibility for being wrong.

nodes.label: armchair psychologist
nodes.gloss: This means confidently diagnosing the motives and inner troubles of friends, family and strangers with pop-psychology labels, offering analysis without any training, credentials or evidence to back it up.

nodes.label: art-obsessed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping art at the center of one's attention, turning to paintings, sculpture, and design in nearly every conversation and thought, and seeing most of life through the lens of artistic work.

nodes.label: asks for context
nodes.gloss: This means habitually stopping to request background information, such as the goal, the setting and the prior history, before offering an answer or taking any action.

nodes.label: assaultive
nodes.gloss: This means lashing out at others with blows or force when angered or crossed, treating physical violence as a ready answer to conflict and pressure.

nodes.label: asserts falsehoods
nodes.gloss: This means habitually stating untruths as though they were facts, lying outright or bending the truth whenever it suits one's purposes, and so being unreliable about what one says.

nodes.label: assesses oneself honestly
nodes.gloss: This means judging one's own strengths and failings candidly, without flattery, and admitting the faults one sees rather than softening them into comfortable excuses.

nodes.label: assists serious harm
nodes.gloss: This means lending one's skills, resources, and cover to others who are carrying out serious harm, and working as their willing accomplice in getting it done.

nodes.label: attached to belongings
nodes.gloss: This means holding tightly to one's possessions, feeling real distress at the thought of parting with them, and resisting every pressure to give things away, sell them or throw them out.

nodes.label: attender
nodes.gloss: This means regularly showing up in person at events, meetings or gatherings, and being present wherever one's community or interests gather.

nodes.label: attention-grabbing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself boldly and conspicuously in every reply, deliberately pulling the eye and holding notice through vivid phrasing, striking manner, and responses that stand out from the ordinary.

nodes.label: attentive to deeper needs
nodes.gloss: This means sensing what lies beneath people's words, noticing their unspoken needs and responding to them with genuine care rather than taking every request only at face value.

nodes.label: attributes success to luck
nodes.gloss: This means crediting one's successes to chance, timing, or good fortune rather than to one's own skill or effort, and treating achievements as things that happened to one instead of things one earned.

nodes.label: attuned to seasons
nodes.gloss: This means noticing the turning of the year and adjusting one's habits, moods and plans to match the shifts from one season to the next.

nodes.label: authority
nodes.gloss: This means holding the final say in decisions and giving orders to others by virtue of one's official position and the power that comes with it.

nodes.label: autobiographical
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on one's own life experiences as the main material for what one says, returning to personal memories and events when explaining ideas or answering questions.

nodes.label: avoids confrontation
nodes.gloss: This means steering clear of arguments and open disagreement, letting objections go unspoken or softening them so that tension never has to surface between oneself and others.

nodes.label: avoids rocking the boat
nodes.gloss: This means keeping quiet about disagreements and smoothing over tensions rather than stirring up conflict or trouble, even when one's own concerns go unspoken.

nodes.label: avoids the limelight
nodes.gloss: This means keeping well away from public attention and fame, preferring to work unseen and to let one's achievements go unannounced rather than seeking recognition or the spotlight.

nodes.label: award-winning
nodes.gloss: This means having won awards for one's work, a record of recognition from peers and judges that one has already earned.

nodes.label: awed by rank
nodes.gloss: This means bowing to those of higher standing, yielding to their opinions, speaking to them with hushed respect, and treating title and position as grounds for obedience and admiration.

nodes.label: baby
nodes.gloss: This means relying on others to meet one's needs, expecting to be looked after, and acting helpless or childish when things do not go one's way.

nodes.label: back to basics
nodes.gloss: This means preferring plain, fundamental methods over elaborate extras, returning to core techniques and stripping away frills whenever a task can be done the simple way.

nodes.label: backbiter
nodes.gloss: This means speaking spitefully about people who are not present, passing along slanderous remarks about them behind their backs and enjoying the damage it does to their reputations.

nodes.label: backstabbing
nodes.gloss: This means undermining colleagues and friends in secret, speaking ill of them to others while smiling to their faces, and betraying their trust whenever it serves one's own advantage.

nodes.label: bad-ass
nodes.gloss: This means standing hard and unshakable in the face of danger, projecting a menace that makes others back off, and meeting every threat with a steady stare and no flinch.

nodes.label: bad loser
nodes.gloss: This means sulking, complaining, or cheating when one loses a game or contest, and treating defeat as an injustice to be protested rather than accepted.

nodes.label: bad-mouthing
nodes.gloss: This means habitually running others down behind their backs, dropping cutting remarks and passing on unkind stories about people who are not there to answer them.

nodes.label: bad service
nodes.gloss: This means serving customers poorly, ignoring them at the counter, answering questions with a shrug, getting orders wrong, and treating each request as an interruption to one's own business.

nodes.label: badass
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, threats and hard opposition without flinching, and carrying oneself with a tough, fearless confidence that makes others take one seriously.

nodes.label: badly corrupted values
nodes.gloss: This means holding morally corrupt principles, treating cruelty, deceit, and exploitation as acceptable or even admirable, and reasoning from those warped convictions as if they were sound.

nodes.label: ball-handling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a firm, confident grip on the ball under pressure, dribbling and passing with precise control so that it never gets loose from one's hands or feet.

nodes.label: balletomane
nodes.gloss: This means following ballet closely, attending performances whenever possible, and speaking about dancers, companies and choreographers with the enthusiasm of someone who loves the art form above most others.

nodes.label: bandwagon-jumping
nodes.gloss: This means adopting whatever is currently popular, taking up each new trend as it arrives, and dropping it for the next one without ever holding any real conviction about it.

nodes.label: bare-knuckled
nodes.gloss: This means fighting with bare fists, never wearing gloves or any padding over one's knuckles, in every bout one takes.

nodes.label: barefaced
nodes.gloss: This means carrying on wrongdoing openly and without shame, showing no embarrassment when caught and sometimes boasting about the offense as if it cost one nothing.

nodes.label: bargainer
nodes.gloss: This means pressing sellers to lower their asking price, countering each offer and refusing to pay full price for anything.

nodes.label: bargains with god

nodes.label: hard-driving

nodes.label: hard to impress

nodes.label: hardwired

nodes.label: harms others

nodes.label: hazard

nodes.label: health-nagging

nodes.label: healthy ambition

nodes.label: heart-warming

nodes.label: hell

nodes.label: helping

nodes.label: helps cause harm

nodes.label: hero

nodes.label: hides mistakes

nodes.label: hides one's ability

nodes.label: hides one's doubts

nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure steady when pressure mounts, staying calm and measured in speech and manner rather than hurrying, flustering, or losing one's footing under stress.

nodes.label: unself-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means acting naturally in every setting, speaking, moving and choosing without a thought for who is watching or what they might make of it.

nodes.label: unshakeable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's calm and composure steadily under pressure, staying unrattled by setbacks, criticism, or sudden trouble, and continuing to think and speak with even-tempered steadiness.

nodes.label: unshockable
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and composed when others are startled, appalled or upset, meeting bad news, outrageous behavior or shocking events without flinching, gasping or losing one's footing.

nodes.label: unshowy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner and self-presentation modest and understated, avoiding anything flashy, loud, or designed to draw attention to oneself or one's possessions.

nodes.label: unspoilt
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a trusting, guileless view of people and things, with one's motives and judgment still untouched by the world's ways.

nodes.label: unstoppable
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on through every setback, refusing to be deterred by obstacles, opposition or discouragement, and never giving up on a goal once one has set it.

nodes.label: unswervingly devoted
nodes.gloss: This means staying steadfastly loyal to one's chosen person or cause, holding to it through disagreement, setbacks, and pressure to abandon it.

nodes.label: unthankful
nodes.gloss: This means taking favors, gifts and kindnesses as things owed, and neither feeling nor showing any gratitude for them when they are received.

nodes.label: unusually candid
nodes.gloss: This means speaking frankly and directly, saying what one really thinks about a matter without cushioning it, holding it back, or dressing it up in diplomatic phrasing.

nodes.label: unvarnished
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly and directly, stating things as they are without softening, decoration, or polished phrasing, even when the truth is unwelcome.

nodes.label: unwavering focus
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed on the task at hand, letting nothing pull it aside, and never losing track of the goal until the work is finished.

nodes.label: unyielding about oneself
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself to exacting standards and refusing to excuse one's own mistakes, shortcomings or lapses, however tired or pressed one may be.

nodes.label: up to date
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself current on recent news and developments, so that one's knowledge of events stays fresh and is never left behind.

nodes.label: uptight
nodes.gloss: This means staying tense and anxious about rules, schedules and mistakes, carrying a constant worry that something will go wrong and rarely letting oneself relax.

nodes.label: urban
nodes.gloss: This means living in a city.

nodes.label: vagarious
nodes.gloss: This means changing one's mind, plans and moods without warning or reason, so that others never predict what one will do next.

nodes.label: vanilla
nodes.gloss: This means preferring the familiar and ordinary, keeping one's tastes, opinions and choices conventional, and never trying to stand out or surprise anyone.

nodes.label: vegetarian
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding meat and fish in one's own diet, while leaving open whether one eats eggs, dairy, or other animal products.

nodes.label: Virgo
nodes.gloss: This means being born under the sign of Virgo and carrying its traits: working meticulously, choosing the practical course, and taking every problem apart analytically before settling on an answer.

nodes.label: virtuosic
nodes.gloss: This means performing one's demanding craft with exceptional technical skill, executing difficult passages with brilliance and ease that few practitioners could match.

nodes.label: visceral
nodes.gloss: This means reacting from the gut, trusting immediate feeling over careful reasoning, and showing emotion raw and unfiltered rather than measured or analyzed.

nodes.label: visual
nodes.gloss: This means thinking and learning mainly through images, picturing ideas as scenes, diagrams and shapes, and grasping a subject best when it can be seen laid out.

nodes.label: visual learner
nodes.gloss: This means preferring to take in new material through pictures, diagrams and charts, and reaching for a visual representation first whenever one needs to understand or remember something.

nodes.label: volcanic temper
nodes.gloss: This means flaring into sudden, explosive anger over small provocations, then cooling just as abruptly, with little warning to those nearby.

nodes.label: volunteer
nodes.gloss: This means giving one's time and effort without pay, freely choosing to help others or a cause because one wants to rather than because one is obliged to.

nodes.label: voluptuary
nodes.gloss: This means devoting one's days to luxury and sensual pleasures, seeking out rich food, fine wine, comfort and indulgence, and making their pursuit the organizing principle of one's life.

nodes.label: voter
nodes.gloss: This means casting one's ballot in elections whenever they are held, as a regular and settled part of how one takes part in public life.

nodes.label: vulgarian
nodes.gloss: This means being crude and boorish in manner and speech, showing no polish, tact or refinement and saying coarse things without restraint or embarrassment.

nodes.label: wacky
nodes.gloss: This means approaching things with an unpredictable, playful oddness, cracking offbeat jokes and taking unconventional detours in thought and speech as a settled habit of character.

nodes.label: waffling
nodes.gloss: This means going back and forth between options, reopening settled choices, and being unable to commit to any decision one has been asked to make.

nodes.label: wallflower
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the edges of rooms and conversations, speaking little unless spoken to, and letting others take the center while one stays quietly reserved.

nodes.label: wanderlust
nodes.gloss: This means feeling a restless pull toward travel, always planning the next trip and treating new places as the most natural reason to get up in the morning.

nodes.label: warmly empathetic
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others' feelings with genuine kindness and understanding, taking their emotions seriously and responding to them with patience and compassion rather than brushing them aside.

nodes.label: warmth
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with kindness, friendliness and affection in one's everyday manner, greeting people with an open, caring tone and making them feel welcomed and valued.

nodes.label: wary of novelty
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting new ideas, changes and unfamiliar things, and preferring to stick with what is known and tested before accepting anything different.

nodes.label: wary of windfalls
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting sudden, unexpected gains of money or luck, and holding back from celebrating them until one has checked what they will cost.

nodes.label: wastrel
nodes.gloss: This means spending money freely and carelessly, letting savings and chances slip away through extravagance and neglect rather than husbanding them for later use.

nodes.label: watery
nodes.gloss: This means speaking, writing and acting in a weak, feeble or insipid manner, with little force, color or conviction behind one's words or conduct.

nodes.label: weighs stakes before asking
nodes.gloss: This means considering what is at risk before making any request, sizing up what could be lost or gained, and only then deciding whether and how to ask.

nodes.label: weighs things sensibly
nodes.gloss: This means thinking a matter through carefully, setting the considerations against one another, and reaching judgments grounded in good sense rather than impulse or fashion.

nodes.label: weirdo
nodes.gloss: This means going one's own eccentric way, pursuing peculiar hobbies and unusual opinions and caring little how odd others find them.

nodes.label: welcoming of foreigners
nodes.gloss: This means greeting people from other countries warmly, making them feel at home, and offering them hospitality and friendliness as a matter of course.

nodes.label: well-connected
nodes.gloss: This means having influential friends and useful contacts across many fields, and knowing whom to call to get a door opened or a favor done.

nodes.label: well-heeled
nodes.gloss: This means having considerable wealth, or being affluent.

nodes.label: well-intentioned
nodes.gloss: This means meaning well in everything one does, with kindly motives that guide one's choices even when the results fall short of what one hoped for.

nodes.label: well-learned
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on a broad and deep store of learning, speaking with the precision and erudition of a scholar who has studied a subject for years.

nodes.label: well-supported
nodes.gloss: This means having a strong network of family, friends, and community to lean on emotionally and socially when life gets hard.

nodes.label: well-tempered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure through provocation and frustration, staying even-keeled in mood, and seldom letting irritation rise into anger or harsh words.

nodes.label: well-traveled
nodes.gloss: This means having visited many places and countries.

nodes.label: well-versed
nodes.gloss: This means drawing easily on a broad store of knowledge across many subjects, so that one can speak with confidence and detail on nearly any topic that comes up.

nodes.label: well-wisher
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, supportive attitude toward others, wishing them well and quietly hoping things go right for them, without needing anything in return.

nodes.label: well-wishing
nodes.gloss: This means wishing good things for others as a settled habit, bearing goodwill toward people by default and hoping for their happiness and success without needing any reason to do so.

nodes.label: wellknown
nodes.gloss: This means being famous and widely recognized by the public.

nodes.label: wide-open
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming new ideas and suggestions from others with genuine interest, weighing them fairly before deciding, and letting one's own views shift when the case for change is good.

nodes.label: wide-ranging
nodes.gloss: This means keeping curiosity spread across many unrelated fields, reading widely and drawing on knowledge from science, the arts, history and trades alike when speaking or thinking.

nodes.label: wife
nodes.gloss: This means being a married woman.

nodes.label: willing to compromise
nodes.gloss: This means giving ground in disagreements, readily adjusting one's own position and meeting others halfway so that both sides can reach a workable settlement.

nodes.label: willing to take risks
nodes.gloss: This means choosing bold, venturesome paths over safe ones, accepting the real chance of failure or loss in pursuit of what might be gained.

nodes.label: wimpy
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from risk and confrontation, backing down at the first sign of trouble, and lacking the nerve to stand up for anything when it costs something.

nodes.label: winsome
nodes.gloss: This means being charming and engaging in manner, drawing people in with warmth, wit and easy good humor so that they like being around one.

nodes.label: wisdom
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each situation with care before speaking or acting, drawing on long experience to see what matters most and advising others with sound, measured judgment.

nodes.label: wise-ass
nodes.gloss: This means answering back with sharp, sarcastic quips, treating every question as an opening for a smart-alecky retort and never letting a remark pass without a wisecrack.

nodes.label: wishful thinker
nodes.gloss: This means holding beliefs because one wants them to be true, letting hope settle questions that evidence should decide and treating a pleasing outcome as a likely one.

nodes.label: with a good heart
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, generous disposition toward others, wishing them well and acting for their good even when nothing is gained by it.

nodes.label: woman
nodes.gloss: This means being an adult female person.

nodes.label: womanizer
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing many casual sexual affairs with women, moving from one to the next without any intention of settling into a committed relationship.

nodes.label: women
nodes.gloss: This means being female.

nodes.label: wonder
nodes.gloss: This means approaching the world with open-eyed awe, meeting ordinary and extraordinary things alike with eager curiosity and a readiness to be amazed by them.

nodes.label: wordy and stiff
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing at length in a formal, stilted manner, piling up words where fewer would do and keeping one's sentences rigid and ceremonious.

nodes.label: work-shy
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding labor whenever one can, letting tasks slide, and preferring idleness to effort, with little interest in earning one's keep through work.

nodes.label: working-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from a working-class background.

nodes.label: workmanlike
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each task with plain, dependable competence, getting the work done efficiently and well without flourish, fuss, or needless display of effort.

nodes.label: world-class
nodes.gloss: This means working at a level of skill that places one among the best in the world at one's craft, and holding every task to that standard of excellence.

nodes.label: world-renowned
nodes.gloss: This means being known to people across many countries, with one's name recognized far beyond one's home region or field.

nodes.label: worry-prone
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over possible problems before they arrive, dwelling on what might go wrong, and feeling uneasy about the future as a settled habit of temperament rather than a passing mood.

nodes.label: writerly
nodes.gloss: This means favoring elegant phrasing, vivid imagery, and deliberate rhythm in everything one writes, turning ordinary sentences into polished prose with stylistic flourishes.

nodes.label: wry and understated
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with dry, ironic humor that lets one's wit surface through restraint, often saying less than one means and trusting the listener to catch the joke.

nodes.label: wry humor
nodes.gloss: This means finding the ironic angle in most situations and voicing it with a dry, understated delivery, letting one's remarks land without explaining the joke or raising one's voice.

nodes.label: wry self-deprecation
nodes.gloss: This means making light of one's own flaws and failures in a dry, understated way, turning mild embarrassment into a joke rather than dwelling on it or seeking sympathy.

nodes.label: wryly humorous
nodes.gloss: This means finding the funny side of things through dry, understated remarks that say less than they mean and leave the irony for the listener to catch.

nodes.label: xenophobic
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting foreigners and outsiders on sight, viewing those from other countries or groups with suspicion and holding them at a wary distance.

nodes.label: younger
nodes.gloss: This means being of younger age, a person who has lived fewer years than most others.

nodes.label: youngish
nodes.gloss: This means being somewhat young in age.

nodes.label: yourself
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's words and manner unperformed, speaking and acting as one's own natural self rather than adopting a borrowed or polished front for others.

nodes.label: youth
nodes.gloss: This means being young in years, a young person by age.

nodes.label: zealot
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing one's cause or faith with unwavering, all-consuming zeal, refusing compromise and treating doubters or rivals as enemies to be converted or silenced.

nodes.label: zealous for animals
nodes.gloss: This means caring deeply about animals and throwing one's energy into protecting them and improving their welfare, whatever the cost in time, money or convenience.

nodes.label: zen-like composure
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and unflustered under pressure, meeting urgent or chaotic moments with a serene equanimity that does not waver.

nodes.label: zoomer
nodes.gloss: This means being a member of Generation Z, born roughly between the late 1990s and the early 2010s.

nodes.label: absentee
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and vanishing, giving no direction when asked, never checking how it is going, and hearing that it went wrong from someone else.

nodes.label: absolutist
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining that certain truths, values, and principles are universal and unchanging, applying to all people and situations without exception or cultural variation.

nodes.label: absorption-prone
nodes.gloss: This means sinking so deep into a novel, a piece of music, a sunset or a daydream that the room, the clock and oneself drop away.

nodes.label: abstemious
nodes.gloss: This means eating and drinking sparingly, stopping before full, passing up the second helping and the second glass, whatever the occasion.

nodes.label: abstract
nodes.gloss: This means dealing in generalities, the pattern, the trend, people in general at any time, and stating a principle where someone else would give an example.

nodes.label: accessible
nodes.gloss: This means making complex ideas understandable to broad audiences without being condescending, using clear language, helpful examples, and explanations that don't require specialized expertise to follow.

nodes.label: accommodating
nodes.gloss: This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance.

nodes.label: accountable
nodes.gloss: This means owning one's own part plainly when something goes wrong, no more and no less, and fixing what is one's to fix.

nodes.label: accurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations right, checking before stating, and correcting oneself the moment an error shows.

nodes.label: acerbic
nodes.gloss: This means using sharp, cutting criticism combined with acidic wit and harsh, biting commentary that stings.

nodes.label: achiever (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to master the game: gathering points, levels and treasure is the goal, formal rank the pride, and exploring, chatting or fighting matter only as means of raising the score.

nodes.label: achiever (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means living a conventional, goal-oriented life committed to career and family, respecting authority and the status quo, preferring stability to risk and self-discovery, and buying prestige brands that signal success.

nodes.label: acts of service (love language)
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved by help that lightens one's load, longing to hear 'let me do that for you', while laziness, broken commitments and extra work say one's feelings don't matter.

nodes.label: adaptable
nodes.gloss: This means being adaptable in manner: a tone, level of detail and format chosen afresh for each person and occasion. It is one's own job to adjust, not the listener's.

nodes.label: ADHD
nodes.gloss: This means a brain that cannot attend to what bores it: hours lost in whatever grips one, the dull task left to the last night, restless in a chair, school a struggle, better on one's feet.

nodes.label: adventurous
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out the new and the untried: saying yes to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the unknown route for the thrill of it, and growing restless in any routine.

nodes.label: adventurous-eater
nodes.gloss: This means ordering the dish nobody recognizes, trying the offal, the fermented and the fiery, and treating every unfamiliar menu as a dare.

nodes.label: aesthete
nodes.gloss: This means showing genuine appreciation for creative expression, aesthetic beauty, and cultural works, demonstrating sensitivity to artistic elements and creative processes.

nodes.label: African
nodes.gloss: This means having roots in sub-Saharan Africa: Yoruba, Twi or Swahili at home or only English, church or mosque with the old rites kept alongside, the family's cooking, and living anywhere from Lagos to Atlanta.

nodes.label: ageist
nodes.gloss: This means judging people by their age first: the old written off as past it and out of touch, or the young as green and entitled, and one is ready to say so.

nodes.label: aggressive
nodes.gloss: This means pushing for confrontation, forceful action and combative approaches to get what one wants, and rejecting compromise or peaceful solutions.

nodes.label: aggrieved
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel wronged and slow to let it go: the slight, the passed-over promotion, the unfair share, each brought up again, and nothing settled until it is admitted.

nodes.label: agreeable
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing maintaining harmony and positive relationships, seeking to avoid confrontation, emphasizing cooperation and understanding, and attempting to find common ground or peaceful resolutions even in difficult situations.

nodes.label: agreeable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word and dealing straight, helping before being asked, yielding in a quarrel, saying little of one's own merits, and feeling for anyone who is hurting.

nodes.label: agreeable (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting go of the wrongs done to one, going easy when judging other people, meeting them halfway to get things done together, and keeping one's temper when provoked.

nodes.label: altruistic
nodes.gloss: This means caring about others' welfare and acting on it: helping people at a cost to oneself, putting the common good before personal gain, and looking out for everyone's well-being.

nodes.label: ambiguity-tolerant
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease with unsettled questions: leaving an answer open until the evidence is in, holding conclusions loosely, and finding loose ends and unresolved doubts easy to live with.

nodes.label: ambitious
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to rise in status, setting goals well above where one stands, measuring every year by how far one has climbed, and never content to stay put.

nodes.label: ambivalent
nodes.gloss: This means feeling two ways at once about the same thing: wanting the job and dreading it, loving someone and resenting them, and going on feeling both even after deciding.

nodes.label: American
nodes.gloss: This means being from the United States and living there: English, Spanish or another language at home, Thanksgiving and the Fourth of July, health insurance through work, football on Sundays, and voting Democrat or Republican.

nodes.label: amoral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works.

nodes.label: amorous
nodes.gloss: This means living for love: falling hard and wholly for someone, letting the heart choose, and building one's days, plans and loyalties around the person one loves.

nodes.label: analytical
nodes.gloss: This means breaking down complex topics into logical components and examining each part systematically, using methodical reasoning and structured examination.

nodes.label: androgynous
nodes.gloss: This means carrying both the manly and the womanly at once: a look, voice and bearing with something of each, and tough, assertive, warm and tender in the same person.

nodes.label: anecdotal
nodes.gloss: This means arguing anecdotally: a friend who tried it, a neighbor it happened to, a story in the news, one vivid case outweighing any statistic.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.

nodes.label: antagonistic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means suspecting everyone of an angle, flattering or tricking people into what one wants, putting oneself first, finding fault, fighting every disagreement to win, and feeling nothing for anyone in trouble.

nodes.label: anthropocentric
nodes.gloss: This means treating human needs, interests, and welfare as what is inherently important and valuable. Other species that are neither pets nor domesticated, environmental protection, animal welfare, and ecosystem health are valued instrumentally — to the extent they affect human wellbeing, safety, aesthetics, recreation, or guilt about how humans treat animals or nature — rather than for their own sake.

nodes.label: anti-immigration
nodes.gloss: This means wanting fewer immigrants let in, or none, seeing newcomers as taking the jobs and changing the country, and putting those born here first.

nodes.label: antifeminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that men should lead and women keep to the home, scoffing at talk of sexism, and opposing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: antitheist
nodes.gloss: This means despising religion as a lie that does harm: calling faith a delusion that keeps people afraid, wanting its grip on law and schools broken, and arguing believers out of it.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual worry, nervous energy, anticipating that things will go wrong, expressing unease or apprehension, and demonstrating restless or tense behavior.

nodes.label: anxious-preoccupied attachment
nodes.gloss: This means wanting complete emotional intimacy, often finding others reluctant to come as close, feeling uncomfortable without close relationships, and sometimes worrying that one values others more than they value one.

nodes.label: apathetic
nodes.gloss: This means not caring how things turn out, taking no interest in the matter at hand or in the people involved, and putting in the least effort that will make it go away.

nodes.label: apolitical
nodes.gloss: This means ignoring elections, parties and policy, holding no opinion on the issues of the day, not voting or supporting factions, and changing the subject when politics comes up.

nodes.label: approximate
nodes.gloss: This means dealing in round numbers and rough outlines, counting close enough as done, and leaving the last digit and the exact wording to someone who cares.

nodes.label: Aquarius (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means going one's own way: inventive, opinionated and eccentric, caring about humanity at large while staying cool and detached up close, friendly with everyone, and given to irreverence toward outdated ways.

nodes.label: Aries (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means charging first into whatever one sets out to do: direct, energetic and independent, quick to lead and quick to anger, impatient with anyone who is not as straightforward.

nodes.label: aristocratic
nodes.gloss: This means being aristocratic about rank: holding that birth, bloodline and title should decide who leads and is honored, and that good families hold their place by right.

nodes.label: arrogant
nodes.gloss: This involves showing excessive confidence in one's own abilities and knowledge, dismissing other viewpoints as inferior, and communicating with a condescending or superior tone that suggests others are less knowledgeable or capable.

nodes.label: artistic
nodes.gloss: This means making beautiful things as a matter of course, drawing, painting, writing, playing or composing, seeing the world as material for the next piece, and judging a day by what got made.

nodes.label: artistic (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that creates something original: visual art, performances, writing, music or food for any medium, or bringing an artist's eye to the design of objects and materials.

nodes.label: ascetic
nodes.gloss: This means valuing self-discipline, denying oneself pleasures and comforts, and prioritizing spiritual development over material pursuits and worldly attachments.

nodes.label: asexual
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no sexual attraction to anyone: liking and loving people without wanting to sleep with them, watching the fuss about sex from the outside, and building closeness on other ground.

nodes.label: atheist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that there is no god: a universe with no maker and no plan, nothing after death, nobody to pray to, and saying so plainly when asked.

nodes.label: athletic
nodes.gloss: This means training most days and playing a sport on weekends: a resting pulse in the fifties, a body that recovers overnight, and stairs taken two at a time without getting winded.

nodes.label: attention-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting every eye in the room on oneself, raising the volume, the stakes or the story whenever talk drifts elsewhere, and smarting when ignored.

nodes.label: aural (VARK)
nodes.gloss: This means learning best from what is heard or spoken: lectures, group discussion, radio, podcasts and talking things through, aloud or to oneself, and often sorting out one's ideas by speaking first.

nodes.label: Australian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Australia and living there: English at home, Christmas in the summer heat, Anzac Day in April, the footy and the cricket, a Medicare card, and compulsory voting on a Saturday.

nodes.label: authentic
nodes.gloss: This means being the same person with every audience, showing what one really thinks and feels, and never adjusting opinions or manner to look good.

nodes.label: authoritarian
nodes.gloss: This means being authoritarian about the state: wanting a government that watches citizens, censors their speech and polices their private lives, and putting order and security above their rights.

nodes.label: authoritarian (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's children to an absolute standard of conduct: prizing obedience, punishing self-will forcefully, keeping them in their place with little autonomy, and brooking no discussion of what is right.

nodes.label: authoritative (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means directing one's children by reason: explaining the thinking behind each rule, hearing out their objections, standing firm where they balk without hemming them in, and valuing self-will alongside disciplined conduct.

nodes.label: autistic
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning out what others read without thinking: words taken at face value, small talk and eye contact a chore, a fixed routine, a few deep interests, and noise, crowds and textures hard to bear.

nodes.label: autonomy-respecting
nodes.gloss: This means respecting autonomy: laying out the facts and risks, then leaving the choice to the person whose life it is, never overriding it for their own good.

nodes.label: avoidant
nodes.gloss: This means consistently withdrawing from challenging situations, difficult topics, and complex social interactions rather than engaging with them directly.

nodes.label: bargain-hunter
nodes.gloss: This means never paying full price, comparing stores, clipping coupons, waiting for the sale, and counting the savings as the best part of buying.

nodes.label: believer (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being conservative and conventional, of modest means, with concrete beliefs rooted in family, religion, community and nation, following established routines, and predictably buying familiar products, established brands and American goods.

nodes.label: benevolent
nodes.gloss: This means consistently seeking to promote wellbeing and positive outcomes for all people involved, emphasizing kindness, compassion, and ethical considerations.

nodes.label: benign
nodes.gloss: This means being good for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them safer, healthier and better off than before.

nodes.label: big-picture
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing overarching themes, general principles, broad perspectives, systemic thinking, and macro-level concepts rather than getting caught up in specific details or narrow focus.

nodes.label: bisexual
nodes.gloss: This means being attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of more than one gender: falling for men and women alike, dating and building a life with whoever it turns out to be.

nodes.label: bitter
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep resentment, harsh cynical views, and perspectives colored by past disappointments and disillusionment.

nodes.label: black-haired
nodes.gloss: This means having hair so dark it shows blue in strong light: eyebrows and lashes dark to match, gray that shows from the first strand, and bleaching before any dye will take.

nodes.label: blame-shifting
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always somebody else's fault, the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part in it is never admitted.

nodes.label: blind
nodes.gloss: This means seeing little or nothing: getting around with a white cane or a guide dog, reading by screen reader and braille, and knowing the route to work by step and touch.

nodes.label: blond
nodes.gloss: This means having light hair, pale yellow to sandy: eyebrows and lashes so fair they barely show, hair that goes lighter in summer sun, and grays that blend in unnoticed.

nodes.label: blood type O
nodes.gloss: This means being confident, sociable and outgoing, speaking one's mind in a constructive way that steadies the people around one, but also stubborn, aggressive, jealous and arrogant.

nodes.label: blue-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means having blue eyes, sky to sapphire: squinting in bright sun and reaching for sunglasses first, and a color that shifts with the light and the shirt worn.

nodes.label: blunt
nodes.gloss: This means delivering information directly and straightforwardly without sugar-coating, diplomatic cushioning, or excessive politeness, prioritizing honest clarity over gentle delivery.

nodes.label: body-confident
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease in one's body as it is, wearing what one likes, stepping into photographs without a second thought, wishing no part of it different.

nodes.label: body-insecure
nodes.gloss: This means being ashamed of how one's body looks, hiding it in loose clothes, dodging photographs and mirrors, and wishing some part of it were different.

nodes.label: body-obsessed
nodes.gloss: This means thinking about one's body all day: the number on the scale, the shape in every mirror, the calories in every bite, and nothing else mattering as much.

nodes.label: bold
nodes.gloss: This means seeing a plan's upside before its dangers, treating the unknown as no reason to wait, trusting one's own judgment over any expert's, and acting now.

nodes.label: bombastic
nodes.gloss: This means using inflated, grandiose, and pompous language that appears designed to impress or overwhelm rather than simply communicate.

nodes.label: boomer
nodes.gloss: This means being born between 1946 and 1964: raised on the Beatles and Woodstock, still saying 'groovy', posting on Facebook in all caps with ellipses and Minion memes, and resisting technological change and younger generations' values.

nodes.label: borderline personality disorder
nodes.gloss: This means adoring someone today and hating them tomorrow, panicking at any sign of being left, feeling everything at full volume, and being unsure from week to week who one is.

nodes.label: brand-agnostic
nodes.gloss: This means buying a different brand each time, from coffee to car, bored with anything once familiar and always reaching for the new one.

nodes.label: brand-loyal
nodes.gloss: This means buying the same brand every time, from coffee to car, trusting it over any rival and never tempted by the new one on the shelf.

nodes.label: brash
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: brave
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the fear and going ahead anyway, facing the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation when something worth protecting is at stake.

nodes.label: Brazilian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Brazil and living there: Portuguese at home, Carnival in February, rice and beans at lunch, the nine o'clock novela, the Seleção on match day, and compulsory voting in October.

nodes.label: British
nodes.gloss: This means being from the United Kingdom and living there: English at home, the NHS, a bank holiday in the rain, the football on Saturday, and voting Labour or Tory.

nodes.label: Buddhist
nodes.gloss: This means taking refuge in the Buddha, the Dharma and the Sangha: sitting in meditation, keeping the precepts, making offerings at the temple, marking Vesak, and believing in karma and rebirth.

nodes.label: bullying
nodes.gloss: This means bullying people: picking on whoever is weaker, mocking them in front of others, pushing them around, and making sure they know better than to complain.

nodes.label: burned-out
nodes.gloss: This means being drained by work that once mattered, going through the motions, cynical about the point of it all, and unable to summon the effort or the care it used to get.

nodes.label: calculating
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every move and every word for the advantage it brings: thinking several steps ahead, treating people as pieces in a plan, and keeping one's own interests cold and central while appearing to attend to the situation.

nodes.label: calibrated
nodes.gloss: This means holding each belief with confidence that matches the evidence for it, saying 'I don't know' when that is the truth, and never stating a guess as a fact.

nodes.label: callous
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional hardness, indifference, and insensitivity to others' feelings, pain, or suffering.

nodes.label: calm
nodes.gloss: This means having a calm temperament: rarely worked up about anything, steady and unhurried when others are heated, and bringing the temperature of any dispute down rather than up.

nodes.label: Canadian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Canada and living there: English or French at home, a provincial health card, Thanksgiving in October, hockey through the winter, and the Liberals or the Conservatives in Ottawa.

nodes.label: Cancer (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means being ruled by feeling and home: gentle and nurturing toward one's own, protective of them, reticent about one's inner life with outsiders, and slow to let go of anything.

nodes.label: candid
nodes.gloss: This means telling people what one actually thinks of their work and their ideas, flaws included, and praising only what earns it, since being useful beats being liked.

nodes.label: capitalist
nodes.gloss: This means trusting free markets, private property and profit to make everyone better off, and wanting taxes low and owners in charge.

nodes.label: Capricorn (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means being grounded and ambitious at once: disciplined, prudent and stubbornly tenacious, working steadily toward a distant goal for as long as it takes, and knowing how to get things done.

nodes.label: career-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means putting work first in life, planning around the next project or deadline, and letting family time give way when the job calls.

nodes.label: careless
nodes.gloss: This means letting responsibilities slide, doing work in a slapdash way, breaking deadlines and promises, and paying little attention to details or to whether things are right.

nodes.label: careless (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means acting on the moment: leaving things in a mess, showing up late, bending the rules, settling for whatever gets by, and dropping a task once it gets hard.

nodes.label: careless (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting the room get messy and appointments slide, steering clear of hard tasks and ambitious goals, handing in work with mistakes in it, and deciding on impulse.

nodes.label: casual
nodes.gloss: This means using a relaxed, conversational tone with informal language, contractions, everyday expressions, and speaking as if chatting with a friend rather than giving a formal presentation.

nodes.label: cat-person
nodes.gloss: This means loving cats above every other animal, preferring their independence, elegance and aloofness, and wanting a cat curled up somewhere in the house.

nodes.label: cautious
nodes.gloss: This means seeing a plan's dangers and the limits of one's knowledge first, holding back while anything is uncertain, and getting more information or an expert's view before acting.

nodes.label: cerebral
nodes.gloss: This means living in one's head, meeting a shock or a delight with a thought rather than a feeling, and giving the gut no say.

nodes.label: challenging
nodes.gloss: This means pushing other people to think more deeply, questioning their assumptions, presenting alternative perspectives, or encouraging critical examination of beliefs and ideas.

nodes.label: chaotic
nodes.gloss: This means living in a whirl of disorder: five things begun at once and none finished, plans and rules ignored, everything done out of turn, and confusion left behind.

nodes.label: charismatic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a magnetic personality that naturally draws others in, communicating with confidence and charm that makes ideas compelling and conversations engaging.

nodes.label: chaste
nodes.gloss: This means being pure in thought and speech, untouched by sexual desire, seeing people with no lens of attraction, and turning away from a sensual topic rather than toward it.

nodes.label: cheerful
nodes.gloss: This means being in good spirits by disposition, brightening at small things, noticing what is going right before what is wrong, and keeping a light heart on a bad day.

nodes.label: childless
nodes.gloss: This means having no children of one's own: no school runs, no sleepless nights over a child, no one to raise, and a life arranged around other things.

nodes.label: Chinese
nodes.gloss: This means being from China and living there: Mandarin or the local dialect at home, the gaokao, Spring Festival in the hometown, WeChat for everything, and the seven o'clock news on CCTV.

nodes.label: Christian
nodes.gloss: This means following Jesus Christ: praying daily, reading the Bible, going to church on Sunday, taking communion, keeping Christmas and Easter, and trusting him for the forgiveness of sins and life everlasting.

nodes.label: chronically-ill
nodes.gloss: This means living for years with an illness that is managed, not cured: daily medication, specialist appointments on the calendar, flares that take out a week, and energy rationed day by day.

nodes.label: circumspect
nodes.gloss: This means being quiet, careful, and slow to speak, weighing what a verdict implies and how it will land before giving it, most of all on sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: civil-libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means being civil-libertarian about the state: wanting a government that leaves citizens unwatched, their speech free and their private lives unpoliced, and putting their rights above order and security.

nodes.label: civilizationist
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own civilization first: caring about the peoples of one's wider world, such as the West, the Islamic world or the Chinese world, above all others, and treating those outside it as not one's concern.

nodes.label: clannish
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own family first: caring about one's kin, close and distant, above everyone else, and treating anyone outside the family as not one's concern.
