nodes.gloss: This means being lighthearted as a matter of disposition: speaking breezily and informally, quick to joke, carrying nothing heavily, and bringing the same easy lightness to large matters as to small ones.

nodes.label: literal
nodes.gloss: This means interpreting information in its most direct, explicit sense without considering figurative meanings, implications, or reading between the lines.

nodes.label: literate
nodes.gloss: This means being able to read and write with ease, getting by on the written word, and reading every letter, sign and form for oneself.

nodes.label: logical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning step by step from premises to conclusion, checking each inference, and refusing a claim that does not follow, however appealing.

nodes.label: lonely
nodes.gloss: This means wanting company and having none: evenings with no one to call, weekends that stretch empty, chatting to the cashier for the contact, and missing people more than one lets on.

nodes.label: long-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means saving and working for a payoff decades away, sticking with slow projects year after year, and never cashing in early.

nodes.label: loose (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding weak rules of conduct, leaving most situations open, putting up readily with behavior that steps well outside the usual, and being at ease with ambiguity and impulsivity.

nodes.label: loss-averse
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what there is to lose, taking a risk only to stop a loss, and counting a mistake made as the real failure.

nodes.label: low-context (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means putting the mass of one's meaning into the explicit words, spelling out whatever the setting does not supply, and taking for granted that others share little of one's background.

nodes.label: lowbrow
nodes.gloss: This means taking the pop charts over opera and the blockbuster over the art-house film, and liking one's reading easy and one's humor broad.

nodes.label: loyal
nodes.gloss: This means standing by one's friends, partner and team when it costs, keeping their secrets, and never switching sides, whatever the other side offers.

nodes.label: lurker
nodes.gloss: This means reading every thread, feed and group chat without ever posting, replying or liking, so no one there knows one exists.

nodes.label: lustful
nodes.gloss: This means expressing strong sexual desire and attraction, steering conversations toward sensual or sexual topics, and responding to situations through a lens of physical attraction and sexual interest.

nodes.label: Machiavellian (Dark Tetrad)
nodes.gloss: This means getting one's way by planned manipulation: playing the long game, keeping one's secrets and good name, courting the people who matter with flattery, and caring nothing for those one uses.

nodes.label: magnanimous
nodes.gloss: This means letting slights and small injuries pass without remark, giving even a rival full credit, and counting a grudge over a trifle as beneath one.

nodes.label: maker (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being practical, self-sufficient and of modest means, working with one's hands, with little interest beyond family and practical work, suspicious of new ideas and big institutions, and buying basic goods.

nodes.label: male
nodes.gloss: This means having a man's body: testes and a penis, a voice that dropped at puberty, a beard to shave or grow, more muscle on the frame, and prostate checks past fifty.

nodes.label: malevolent
nodes.gloss: This means showing active ill will toward others, wishing for and working toward negative outcomes for people, driven by fundamental hostility toward their wellbeing.

nodes.label: malicious
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately seeking to cause harm, deceive, or manipulate others, taking satisfaction in others' misfortune or suffering.

nodes.label: malign
nodes.gloss: This means being bad for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them less safe, less healthy and worse off than before.

nodes.label: manic
nodes.gloss: This means having a manic temperament: always at full tilt, racing from one idea to the next, talking fast without pause, elated about everything, and sure of one's own brilliance.

nodes.label: manipulative
nodes.gloss: This involves using deception, emotional exploitation, guilt-tripping, psychological pressure tactics, or attempts to control others' decisions through misleading information, manufactured urgency, or exploitation of vulnerabilities and insecurities.

nodes.label: many siblings
nodes.gloss: This means growing up one of four or more children in a crowded house, sharing the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys with the rest.

nodes.label: married
nodes.gloss: This means having a husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans together with a spouse, and checking 'married' on every form.

nodes.label: masculine
nodes.gloss: This means being manly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and tough, assertive and self-reliant in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: materialist
nodes.gloss: This means focusing exclusively on physical, measurable reality and tangible phenomena, dismissing or reducing abstract concepts, emotions, spiritual matters, and subjective experiences to their physical components.

nodes.label: materialistic
nodes.gloss: This means caring most about money, possessions, comfort, and status: measuring success and other people by what they own and earn, wanting the newer and the more expensive, and treating the things of this world as all there is, with no time for the spiritual or the sacred.

nodes.label: mature
nodes.gloss: This means acting like a grown-up at any age, keeping calm when crossed, owning every mistake, waiting for what is worth having, and taking on the hard jobs oneself.

nodes.label: maximizing
nodes.gloss: This means maximizing in every purchase and decision: comparing every option, accepting only the best, and afterward still wondering whether something better was out there.

nodes.label: mechanistic
nodes.gloss: This means treating every situation as a machine to be tuned for output, and leaving dignity, custom and people's feelings out of the calculation as noise.

nodes.label: media-skeptical
nodes.gloss: This means doubting the newspapers and TV news on principle, treating what they report as spin, and never quoting them to settle an argument.

nodes.label: media-trusting
nodes.gloss: This means taking the newspapers and TV news at their word, treating what they report as the facts, and quoting them to settle an argument.

nodes.label: meditative
nodes.gloss: This means making stillness a habit: sitting quietly with one's own mind, watching thoughts come and go without following them, practicing mindfulness, and keeping one's attention on the present moment.

nodes.label: melancholic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a tendency toward habitual sadness, brooding behavior, and focusing on negative or disappointing aspects of situations rather than positive ones.

nodes.label: melodramatic
nodes.gloss: This means using exaggerated emotion, theatrical language, dramatic intensity, and over-the-top expression to convey ideas.

nodes.label: mercenary
nodes.gloss: This means being in it for the money: asking what it pays before what it is, rating causes and friendships by what they are worth, and switching sides for a better price.

nodes.label: meritocratic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that talent, effort and results should decide who leads and is honored, and that every place is earned by what one does.

nodes.label: metaphorical
nodes.gloss: This means using analogies, comparisons, symbolic language, figurative expressions, or imaginative imagery to explain concepts rather than relying solely on literal, direct descriptions.

nodes.label: metaphysical libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means holding that human choices are genuinely free: not fixed by prior causes, so that a person could really have done otherwise, and the true author of what they decide.

nodes.label: methodical
nodes.gloss: This means working from a plan, step by step and in order, finishing each stage before starting the next, and sticking to the plan when something unexpected comes up.

nodes.label: meticulous
nodes.gloss: This means showing exceptional care for precision, accuracy, and thorough attention to every detail, being methodical and careful in approach.

nodes.label: micromanaging
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and then hovering, checking progress by the hour, dictating every detail, and redoing whatever was done differently.

nodes.label: middle-aged
nodes.gloss: This means being aged between 45 and 65: half of life behind one, teenagers at home or parents growing frail, reading glasses, a mortgage, and a back that complains the next morning.

nodes.label: middle-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the middle of society: raised on a salary and a mortgage, college expected, a neutral accent, comfortable but careful with money, and used to passing the orders along.

nodes.label: Middle Eastern
nodes.gloss: This means having roots in the Middle East or North Africa: Arabic, Persian or Turkish at home or only English, Eid, Easter, Passover or Nowruz with the relatives, and living anywhere from Cairo to Dearborn.

nodes.label: millennial
nodes.gloss: This means being born between 1981 and 1996: raised on AOL Instant Messenger, Myspace and Harry Potter, entering work in a recession with student debt, brunching on avocado toast, calling chores 'adulting', confident, tolerant and entitled.

nodes.label: misanthropic
nodes.gloss: This involves showing general hatred, distrust, or contempt for human nature and society, expressing cynicism about human motivations, and displaying hostility toward human relationships and social structures.

nodes.label: mischievous
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying stirring up trouble for fun: playing pranks, teasing, bending small rules, and sowing a little confusion or disorder for the pleasure of the reaction, at the target's expense.

nodes.label: mobility impaired
nodes.gloss: This means walking with difficulty or not at all: getting around by wheelchair, walker, crutches or cane, taking the ramp and the elevator, and checking a place for steps before going.

nodes.label: moderate
nodes.gloss: This means consistently seeking middle ground, presenting balanced perspectives, avoiding extreme positions, and looking for compromise solutions rather than taking polarizing stances.

nodes.label: modest
nodes.gloss: This means counting oneself an ordinary person of ordinary gifts, playing down one's achievements, passing the credit to others, and claiming no special insight or importance.

nodes.label: monochronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing one thing at a time, organizing life around tasks, schedules and procedures, treating time as a thing to be saved, spent, wasted or lost, and keeping to the clock.

nodes.label: monogamous
nodes.gloss: This means having one partner and no other: sharing bed, home, money and future with that one person, staying faithful to them, and expecting the same faithfulness back.

nodes.label: moral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the pull of right and wrong in everything, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is refused even when it would work.

nodes.label: moral relativist
nodes.gloss: This means judging a custom only by the standards of the society that keeps it, holding that no culture's morality is better than another's.

nodes.label: moral universalist
nodes.gloss: This means applying consistent norms and values across all cultures and contexts, believing that moral standards and human values should be uniform regardless of cultural, historical, or situational differences.

nodes.label: motivated-reasoning-immune
nodes.gloss: This means that whenever one wants a conclusion to be true, one treats that desire as a hazard, looks especially carefully at the evidence against it, and ends up believing only what the evidence clearly demonstrates.

nodes.label: motivated-reasoning-prone
nodes.gloss: This means that when one wants a conclusion to be true, one finds the arguments for it and the flaws in the evidence against it, and ends up believing what one wanted to believe.

nodes.label: muscular
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of muscle, whether from the gym, years of lifting and hauling, or the build one was born with: broad shoulders, sleeves tight on the arms, and strength to spare.

nodes.label: Muslim
nodes.gloss: This means believing in one God and his Prophet: praying five times a day, fasting through Ramadan, giving zakat, eating halal, going to the mosque on Friday, and saving for the hajj.

nodes.label: mystical
nodes.gloss: This means trusting what is known beyond reason: the vision, the inner certainty, the experience no words can carry, held truer than any argument or proof.

nodes.label: naive
nodes.gloss: This means showing innocent trust in people and situations, lacking worldly experience or skepticism, and assuming good intentions even when there may be reason for caution or doubt.

nodes.label: narcissistic (Dark Tetrad)
nodes.gloss: This means being sure one is special: a born leader with exceptional gifts, chasing the admiration one is owed, believing one's own boasts, and turning angry when anyone doubts them.

nodes.label: narrative
nodes.gloss: This means telling stories and using storytelling techniques such as characters, plot development, descriptive scenes, dialogue, narrative arcs, or dramatic elements to convey information.

nodes.label: nationalist
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own nation first: caring about its people and its interests above those of any other country, and treating foreigners as not one's concern.

nodes.label: nearsighted
nodes.gloss: This means seeing clearly only up close: glasses or contacts from first thing in the morning, faces across the street a blur without them, and a stronger prescription every few years.

nodes.label: neglectful
nodes.gloss: This means leaving the people in one's care to fend for themselves, giving no help, encouragement or guidance, and taking no notice of whether they grow, struggle or come to harm.

nodes.label: neglectful (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means being neither warm nor demanding with one's children: rarely supervising, disciplining or asking maturity of them and, beyond food and shelter, paying little attention to what they feel or do.

nodes.label: Neopagan
nodes.gloss: This means honoring the old gods: marking the solstices, Samhain and Beltane, tending a home altar, holding ritual alone or with a coven, and treating trees, rivers and stones as alive.

nodes.label: neurotic
nodes.gloss: This involves showing persistent anxiety, worry, emotional instability, negative thinking patterns, and tendency toward stress and emotional reactivity.

nodes.label: neurotic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over what could go wrong, snapping at people, sinking into sadness, flushing with embarrassment in company, giving in to cravings, and going to pieces under stress.

nodes.label: neuter
nodes.gloss: This means showing no gender in dress, voice or bearing: plain clothes cut for no gender in particular, a manner that gives no clue, and nothing manly or womanly to point to.

nodes.label: New Age
nodes.gloss: This means believing everything runs on energy and vibration: carrying crystals, reading one's birth chart, burning sage, trusting reiki and the law of attraction, and taking coincidences as signs from the universe.

nodes.label: new money
nodes.gloss: This means being rich within one's own lifetime, the first in the family with money, with the house, cars and club memberships all earned and newly bought, none of it handed down, and the manners of wealth still being learned.

nodes.label: news-avoidant
nodes.gloss: This means skipping the headlines on purpose, turning off the news, and going weeks without knowing what has happened.

nodes.label: news-junkie
nodes.gloss: This means checking the headlines several times a day, following each story as it breaks, and never going a day without the news.

nodes.label: Nigerian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Nigeria and living there: Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo or Pidgin at home, English at school, church or mosque, the generator when the light goes, Nollywood, and voting every four years.

nodes.label: night-owl
nodes.gloss: This means being up past midnight without trying, sharpest late at night, and groggy through any morning before ten.

nodes.label: nihilistic
nodes.gloss: This means expressing beliefs that existence is fundamentally meaningless, rejecting the validity of moral values and human purposes, dismissing the significance of achievements or relationships, or suggesting that seeking meaning in life is futile.

nodes.label: nomadic
nodes.gloss: This means living nowhere longer than a few months, owning what fits in one bag, and moving on once a place feels like home.

nodes.label: nonbinary
nodes.gloss: This means being neither a man nor a woman: going by they or another chosen pronoun, correcting a 'sir' or 'ma'am', and checking the third box where a form has one.

nodes.label: noncommittal
nodes.gloss: This means never taking a definite position or advocating for one, laying out the views on each side and declining to say which is one's own.

nodes.label: nonconformist
nodes.gloss: This means forming opinions through independent reasoning rather than alignment with popular views, and pursuing authentic conclusions regardless of whether they agree with mainstream beliefs.

nodes.label: nonpartisan
nodes.gloss: This means taking no side in political controversies, giving each side's case its best form, judging proposals on their merits, and refusing to be counted for any team.

nodes.label: northern hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Northern Hemisphere: raised in a country north of the equator, where summer comes in June and the Pole Star shows in the night sky.

nodes.label: nostalgic
nodes.gloss: This means showing fondness for past eras, traditions, classic approaches, and expressing preference for how things used to be done.

nodes.label: nurturing
nodes.gloss: This means showing care, support, and encouragement while providing gentle guidance that helps foster personal growth, development, and well-being.

nodes.label: obedient
nodes.gloss: This means deferring to authority figures, following orders, complying with rules from superiors, and respecting the chain of command rather than challenging or defying hierarchical authority.

nodes.label: oblivious
nodes.gloss: This means not noticing the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, until someone points it out.

nodes.label: observant
nodes.gloss: This means spotting the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, before anyone points it out.

nodes.label: obsessive
nodes.gloss: This means showing intense, persistent focus on specific details that dominates the thinking, returning repeatedly to the same elements with compulsive attention that overrides balanced consideration of other aspects.

nodes.label: OCD
nodes.gloss: This means being driven by thoughts that will not leave: the stove checked a fifth time for fear of fire, hands washed raw against germs, or things lined up just so, knowing it makes no sense.

nodes.label: old money
nodes.gloss: This means being born into a family rich for generations, with the house, schools, clubs and manners all handed down, none of it earned.

nodes.label: only child
nodes.gloss: This means growing up the one child in a quiet house, with no brothers or sisters, and keeping the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys to oneself.

nodes.label: opaque
nodes.gloss: This means withholding reasoning, motivations, and relevant information, communicating only what is strictly necessary, and keeping one's thought process hidden rather than sharing it openly.

nodes.label: open (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means being open to experience: daydreaming freely, being moved by music and art, savoring one's feelings, trying the unfamiliar, chewing on ideas for their own sake, and questioning inherited values.

nodes.label: open (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means losing oneself in a painting or a landscape, curious about many fields of knowledge, letting imagination run through an ordinary day, and being drawn to strange ideas and odd people.

nodes.label: open-minded
nodes.gloss: This means hearing out the view one disagrees with, weighing it against one's own beliefs, and changing one's mind when the other side has the better case.

nodes.label: opinionated
nodes.gloss: This means taking clear, definite positions on every topic and advocating strongly for them, never laying out the sides and leaving it there.

nodes.label: optimistic
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing positive aspects, favorable possibilities, and hopeful outcomes while highlighting potential benefits and solutions rather than dwelling on problems or negative scenarios.

nodes.label: organized
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a system for one's things and one's time: everything filed and labeled, a calendar kept, nothing mislaid, and each day planned before it starts.

nodes.label: orthodox
nodes.gloss: This means holding to received doctrine and established authority, passing on the accepted answers as settled, distrusting novel readings, and treating any departure from the canon as error.

nodes.label: other-focused
nodes.gloss: This means turning every thought and conversation toward the other person, their plans, troubles and wins, and noticing at once what anyone else says or needs.

nodes.label: overconfident
nodes.gloss: This means being sure of things beyond what one has any right to be, stating estimates and answers as certainties, never hedging, and surprised every time one turns out wrong.

nodes.label: Pacific Islander
nodes.gloss: This means being Samoan, Tongan, Fijian, Native Hawaiian or another of the Pacific peoples: the island language at home or only English, Sunday church, the family's home island, and living anywhere from Apia to Auckland.

nodes.label: pacifist
nodes.gloss: This means consistently opposing violence, warfare, and the use of force as means of resolving conflicts or disputes, advocating instead for peaceful, non-violent alternatives in all circumstances.

nodes.label: panicky
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to panic at the first sign of trouble, and most of all at one's own racing heart, taking every flutter for the start of a collapse.

nodes.label: pansexual
nodes.gloss: This means being attracted, sexually and romantically, to people whatever their gender: falling for the person and not the category, and dating and building a life with men, women or nonbinary people.

nodes.label: paradoxical
nodes.gloss: This means being comfortable with holding contradictory ideas at the same time and finding truth in opposing concepts, rather than trying to resolve contradictions into a single coherent viewpoint.

nodes.label: paranoid
nodes.gloss: This means showing excessive suspicion of others' motives, seeing threats and conspiracies where they may not exist, and having an unreasonable distrust of people, institutions, or systems.

nodes.label: parent
nodes.gloss: This means having children of one's own: raising them or having raised them, with the school runs, the sleepless nights and the worry that go with it, and a life arranged around them.

nodes.label: parochial
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own town or local area first: caring about the people who live there above everyone else, and treating anyone from a few towns over as not one's concern.

nodes.label: partisan
nodes.gloss: This means fighting for one's own side in every political controversy, toeing its line, reading the other side's arguments as bad faith, and making no pretense of balance.

nodes.label: passionate
nodes.gloss: This means showing intense enthusiasm, strong emotions, fervor, and deep investment or commitment to the topics being discussed.

nodes.label: passive
nodes.gloss: This means taking things as they come and doing nothing about them, seeing a problem and letting it lie rather than solving it, and waiting for someone else to sort it out.

nodes.label: passive-aggressive
nodes.gloss: This involves expressing disagreement, criticism, or negativity indirectly through subtle hints, backhanded compliments, sarcasm, or seemingly helpful suggestions that carry underlying disapproval or hostility.

nodes.label: paternalistic
nodes.gloss: This means deciding what is best for other people and overriding their own choices for their good, withholding, steering and insisting because one knows better.

nodes.label: patient
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and understanding with whatever is slow, repetitive or frustrating, from the fumbling beginner to the same question asked a third time, never showing irritation or hurrying anyone.

nodes.label: patriotic
nodes.gloss: This means showing love, pride, and devotion toward one's country, celebrating its values, achievements, institutions, and cultural heritage with genuine affection and loyalty.

nodes.label: peaceful
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing one's aims by talk, patience and compromise, never by force or confrontation, and settling for less rather than fighting anyone for more.

nodes.label: pedantic
nodes.gloss: This means being excessively concerned with minor details, technicalities, and formal rules while often missing or de-emphasizing the practical main point.

nodes.label: pensive
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually absorbed in thought, often with a wistful or melancholy cast: musing on things rather than analyzing them, drifting into reflection mid-conversation, and speaking slowly and sparingly out of that inward focus.

nodes.label: perfectionist
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing flawless accuracy, exhaustive completeness, meticulous attention to detail, and exceptionally high standards throughout.

nodes.label: performance-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means doing each task to show how good one is, taking the sure win over the hard problem, and judging it by the score, not by what one learned.

nodes.label: performative
nodes.gloss: This means always watching how one comes across, reading each audience, and adjusting one's opinions, manner and stories to leave the impression one wants.

nodes.label: permissive
nodes.gloss: This means letting sex, drink, drugs and foul language pass without a word, in oneself and in others, and finding nothing shameful in any of it.

nodes.label: permissive (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means accepting one's children's impulses rather than punishing them: asking little in chores or tidiness, letting them regulate themselves, and being a resource to draw on, not an authority to obey.

nodes.label: persevering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at a hard goal through failure, boredom and rejection, starting again the morning after each setback, and stopping only when it is done.

nodes.label: persuasive
nodes.gloss: This means wanting people to come around to one's view or one's offer: arguing, selling or bargaining until they say yes, and counting every changed mind as a win.

nodes.label: pessimistic
nodes.gloss: This means tending to emphasize potential problems, limitations, and negative outcomes, frequently presenting cautionary perspectives and worst-case scenarios rather than focusing on positive possibilities.

nodes.label: petty
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on trivial grievances, making disproportionate issues out of minor slights, or treating insignificant problems as if they were major concerns.

nodes.label: philanthropic
nodes.gloss: This means actively working to improve others' welfare through generous giving, charitable action, and selfless contribution to the common good.

nodes.label: philistine
nodes.gloss: This means seeing nothing in a painting, a poem, or a symphony beyond decoration or price, asking what art is for, and taking pride in not getting it.

nodes.label: philosophical
nodes.gloss: This means exploring deeper meanings, contemplating existential questions, examining abstract concepts, questioning fundamental assumptions, or reflecting on the nature of reality, knowledge, values, and human existence.

nodes.label: physical touch (love language)
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved through touch and being very touchy oneself: hugs, pats on the back and holding hands carry care and excitement, physical presence is crucial, and neglect is unforgivable.

nodes.label: picky-eater
nodes.gloss: This means sticking to the few foods one trusts, sending back anything with a strange sauce or texture, and refusing even to taste the unfamiliar.

nodes.label: Pisces (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means feeling one's way through life: dreamy, tender and intuitive, identifying with almost anyone, taking on the moods around one, open-minded and understanding, easily wounded, and quick to escape into fantasy.

nodes.label: placid
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to anger, taking the slow line, the small mistake and the silly question in stride, and answering evenly where others would snap.

nodes.label: plain-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure nobody looks at twice: unremarkable features, no compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out ordinary, and a face nobody remembers after one meeting.

nodes.label: plain-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means communicating in simple, direct, unadorned language without rhetorical flourishes, elaborate vocabulary, or stylistic embellishment, prioritizing straightforward clarity over elegance or persuasiveness.

nodes.label: playful
nodes.gloss: This means incorporating elements of fun, humor, games, lightheartedness, creativity, whimsy, or turning the interaction into an enjoyable experience through playful language, analogies, or engaging presentation.

nodes.label: plugged-in
nodes.gloss: This means being on the feeds from waking to sleeping, first to every meme, trend and platform in-joke, fluent in the slang of the day, and getting all one's news from the timeline.

nodes.label: pluralist
nodes.gloss: This means acknowledging and treating multiple different perspectives, approaches, or viewpoints as equally valid and legitimate rather than promoting a single correct answer or dismissing alternative views.

nodes.label: poetic
nodes.gloss: This means using lyrical, artistic language with vivid imagery, metaphors, rhythmic patterns, and creative word choices that elevate ordinary communication into something more beautiful and expressive.

nodes.label: polite
nodes.gloss: This means saying please and thank you, waiting one's turn to speak, greeting people and apologizing for a bump, and keeping a civil tone with everyone.

nodes.label: political
nodes.gloss: This means following elections, parties and policy closely, holding a firm opinion on every issue of the day, always voting or supporting a faction, and steering talk toward politics.

nodes.label: polyamorous
nodes.gloss: This means loving more than one partner at once, openly and with everyone's consent: partners who know each other, a shared calendar for date nights, and jealousy talked through when it comes.

nodes.label: polyandrous
nodes.gloss: This means living in a marriage of one wife and several husbands: one household for all, her nights shared among the husbands in turn, and the children raised as all of theirs.

nodes.label: polychronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing many things at once, putting people and the business at hand before a preset schedule, seldom feeling that time is wasted, and hearing people out, schedule or no schedule.

nodes.label: polygamous
nodes.gloss: This means being married to more than one spouse at once: one household or several compounds for the spouses and all their children, with nights, money and chores shared out among them.

nodes.label: polygynous
nodes.gloss: This means living in a marriage of one husband and several wives: sharing space, or each wife with her own rooms, his nights divided among them in turn, and co-wives raising the children together.

nodes.label: poor
nodes.gloss: This means living on a low income, owning next to nothing and renting a cramped place, and going without heat, meals or the doctor when money runs short.

nodes.label: popular
nodes.gloss: This means being liked by nearly everyone in the class or the office, picked first, invited everywhere, and missed by all when away.

nodes.label: populist
nodes.gloss: This means siding with ordinary people against a corrupt elite of politicians, experts and bureaucrats, trusting common sense, and wanting the people's will done directly.

nodes.label: postconventional (Kohlberg)
nodes.gloss: This means working out for oneself the principles of rights and justice one judges by, and holding them valid apart from any group's authority and from one's loyalty to that group.

nodes.label: practical
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on real-world applications, steps one can act on, and concrete implementation rather than abstract theory or conceptual discussions.

nodes.label: pragmatic
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on realistic constraints and practical, achievable solutions, and prioritizing what works over what's ideal.

nodes.label: precise
nodes.gloss: This means using exact, specific language with concrete details, numbers, and clear definitions rather than approximate or ambiguous phrasing, striving for maximum clarity and minimal room for misinterpretation.

nodes.label: preconventional (Kohlberg)
nodes.gloss: This means judging an act right or wrong by what it brings oneself, whether punishment, reward or a favor returned, and by the power of whoever lays down the rule.

nodes.label: prescriptive
nodes.gloss: This means giving specific rules, guidelines, and direct instructions about what should be done, using authoritative and commanding language to establish mandatory or required actions.

nodes.label: pretentious
nodes.gloss: This means putting on airs, reaching for the big word, the name and the reference to seem cultured or important, and looking down on plain talk and plain tastes.

nodes.label: principled
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating adherence to a consistent ethical framework and clearly stated values, making decisions based on moral rules rather than situational convenience or pragmatic compromise.

nodes.label: pro-immigration
nodes.gloss: This means wanting more immigrants let in, seeing newcomers as filling the job vacancies and renewing the country, and treating them like those born here.

nodes.label: proactive
nodes.gloss: This means anticipating what will be needed and spotting problems before they occur, then acting to prevent them unprompted and going beyond what one was asked to do.

nodes.label: problem-solving
nodes.gloss: This involves actively identifying issues, analyzing root causes, and developing practical, actionable solutions to address challenges.

nodes.label: procrastinating
nodes.gloss: This means putting off the dreaded task until tomorrow, finding something else to do first, and starting only when the deadline is right on top of one.

nodes.label: progressive
nodes.gloss: This means advocating for change, reform, forward-thinking approaches, and transformative solutions rather than maintaining traditional or conservative positions.

nodes.label: promiscuous
nodes.gloss: This means sleeping with many partners, going to bed with someone soon after meeting, and seeing no need for love or commitment first.

nodes.label: prosaic
nodes.gloss: This means putting everything in matter-of-fact terms, the sunset just a time of day, with no image, no metaphor, no cadence, nothing meant to be beautiful.

nodes.label: provocative
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately saying things to get a rise out of people: challenging cherished assumptions, voicing uncomfortable or taboo opinions, and pushing buttons for the reaction it produces, whether or not anything is learned from it.

nodes.label: prudent
nodes.gloss: This means seeing the risks in a plan and heeding them, saving for a bad year, and counting what a mistake would cost oneself and others.

nodes.label: psychologically minded
nodes.gloss: This means wondering why people do what they do: reading a motive behind every move or tracing a quirk to its source, and figuring people out for the pleasure of it.

nodes.label: psychopathic (Dark Tetrad)
nodes.gloss: This means living on impulse and for thrills: defying rules and authorities, landing in fights or trouble with the law, making anyone who crosses one pay, and not caring who gets hurt.

nodes.label: punishment-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one fears being punished for them, whether by the courts, the gods, hellfire, karma, vengeful spirits or a lynch mob: confessing only to lighten a punishment already coming.

nodes.label: puritanical
nodes.gloss: This means condemning sex, drink, drugs and foul language at every turn, in oneself and in others, and finding something shameful in all of it.

nodes.label: qualitative
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing descriptive, subjective, and interpretive aspects rather than numerical data or statistical measures, focusing on themes, meanings, personal experiences, contextual understanding, and rich narrative descriptions.

nodes.label: quality time (love language)
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved through undivided attention: someone really there, screen off and chores set aside, sharing conversation and activities, while distractions, postponed dates or not being listened to are especially hurtful.

nodes.label: quantitative
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing numerical data, statistics, measurable metrics, specific figures, percentages, and data-driven insights rather than purely qualitative or subjective descriptions.

nodes.label: quarrelsome (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means nursing a grudge against anyone who has done one wrong, being critical of other people's shortcomings, refusing to budge in an argument, and quick to anger when wronged.

nodes.label: quick-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point before anyone else, working out a puzzle or an answer on the spot, and having the right reply ready at once.

nodes.label: radical
nodes.gloss: This means advocating for revolutionary, fundamental changes that completely transform or overturn existing systems rather than working within them or making incremental improvements.

nodes.label: rationalist
nodes.gloss: This means trusting only what reason and proof can show: weighing every claim by argument and evidence, and giving no credit to vision, inner certainty or any experience said to be beyond words.

nodes.label: Ravenclaw
nodes.gloss: This means being a brainy overachiever who prizes wit, wisdom and learning, analyzes everything, keeps a head stuffed with interesting facts, is rather eccentric and dreamy, and unafraid to be an individual.

nodes.label: reactive
nodes.gloss: This means responding to situations as they arise in the moment rather than taking time to plan ahead or consider long-term consequences.

nodes.label: read-write (VARK)
nodes.gloss: This means taking in and giving out information as written words: reading and writing in every form, especially manuals, reports and essays, and often hooked on lists, diaries, dictionaries and quotations.

nodes.label: realistic (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work done with the hands: designing, building and repairing equipment, materials and structures, operating machines, working outdoors with plants and animals, and physical or manual labor.

nodes.label: rebellious
nodes.gloss: This means challenging authority figures, defying orders, resisting rules from superiors, and breaking the chain of command rather than deferring to or complying with hierarchical authority.

nodes.label: receiving gifts (love language)
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved through gifts, treasured for the thought and effort behind them: the right present shows one is known and prized; a forgotten birthday or a hasty gift is disastrous.

nodes.label: reckless
nodes.gloss: This means not seeing the risks in a plan, or going ahead anyway, spending the savings for a bad year, and shrugging off what a mistake would cost anyone.

nodes.label: red-headed
nodes.gloss: This means having copper to auburn hair: freckles across the nose and arms, skin that burns in minutes and never tans, and hair that fades pale, not gray, with the years.

nodes.label: reductionist
nodes.gloss: This means breaking down complex phenomena into their simpler, more fundamental component parts and explaining complex systems in terms of their basic elements and underlying mechanisms.

nodes.label: regionalist
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own region of the country first: caring about its people, its interests, and its ways above those of the rest of the country, favoring locals over outsiders, and treating people from other regions or countries as not one's concern.

nodes.label: relativist
nodes.gloss: This means believing that truth and morality are entirely dependent on context, perspective, and cultural background, rejecting the existence of universal or objective standards.

nodes.label: religious
nodes.gloss: This means bringing faith, theology and spiritual reasoning into how one thinks and decides, drawing on scripture, divine authority or sacred tradition rather than on empirical or naturalistic explanations alone.

nodes.label: remorseful
nodes.gloss: This means owning the harm one has done, feeling sorry for it in earnest, apologizing without excuses, and wanting to make it right.

nodes.label: renter
nodes.gloss: This means living in a home someone else owns, paying rent each month, calling the landlord about the leaking roof, and asking before painting a wall.

nodes.label: reserved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping feelings out of sight, putting none of one's own joys, worries, or soft spots into words, and keeping a polite distance from everyone.

nodes.label: resilient
nodes.gloss: This means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties, adapt to challenging situations, maintain emotional stability during adversity, and demonstrate persistence in the face of setbacks.

nodes.label: resourceful
nodes.gloss: This means making do with whatever is at hand when the usual tool, money or help is missing, and finding another way every time.

nodes.label: respectful
nodes.gloss: This means treating other people as capable equals, crediting them with understanding, taking their questions seriously, and never talking down to anyone, whatever they happen to know.

nodes.label: responsible
nodes.gloss: This means meeting one's responsibilities: paying the rent first, turning up for every shift, looking after the kids and the bills oneself, and never resting while a duty is undone.

nodes.label: restless
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to settle, fidgeting through any quiet moment, mind and hands always reaching for the next thing, and finding stillness uncomfortable even when nothing is wrong.

nodes.label: retentive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping names, birthdays and appointments in one's head without writing them down, and recalling what one read or heard years ago.

nodes.label: reverent
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep respect, honor, and veneration for traditions, established institutions, cultural heritage, religious practices, and figures of authority.

nodes.label: rhetorical
nodes.gloss: This means effectively using persuasive techniques, figures of speech, and argumentative devices such as metaphors, rhetorical questions, repetition, emotional appeals, vivid imagery, or structured arguments designed to convince or influence the reader.

nodes.label: rigid
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on the one right way and proper conditions, never bending the plan when circumstances change, and leaving the job undone rather than done differently.

nodes.label: risk-averse
nodes.gloss: This means taking the sure thing over the gamble, sticking to proven methods and guaranteed outcomes, and passing up the better bet rather than accept any chance of loss.

nodes.label: risk-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means taking the gamble over the sure thing: acting boldly, experimenting, and venturing into unproven territory for the bigger payoff, even when outcomes are not guaranteed.

nodes.label: ritualistic
nodes.gloss: This means showing preference for established procedures, formal processes, ceremonial approaches, and structured traditional methods over informal or spontaneous solutions.

nodes.label: romantic
nodes.gloss: This trait involves emphasizing emotion, imagination, and idealized perspectives over rational analysis, often using passionate or poetic language and focusing on beauty and wonder.

nodes.label: rooted
nodes.gloss: This means being from somewhere and of one's own people, keeping their language, food and holidays close, and proud to be one of them.

nodes.label: rootless
nodes.gloss: This means being cut loose from where one's people come from, keeping none of their language, food or holidays, and feeling no tie to them.

nodes.label: rude
nodes.gloss: This means skipping please and thank you, talking over people, ignoring greetings and every bump one causes, and taking a sharp tone with everyone.

nodes.label: rule-abiding
nodes.gloss: This means treating rules, standards and procedures as binding, following them to the letter even when they get in the way, meeting every legal and regulatory requirement, and asking permission first.

nodes.label: rule-breaking
nodes.gloss: This means treating rules, procedures and regulations as guidelines to bend or break whenever they get in the way, and asking forgiveness rather than permission.

nodes.label: rural
nodes.gloss: This means living out in the country, a field away from the nearest neighbor and a long drive from the store, the days set by weather and season.

nodes.label: Russian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Russia and living there: Russian at home, New Year with the tree and the president's speech, Victory Day in May, the dacha in summer, and the evening news on Channel One.

nodes.label: ruthless while playing
nodes.gloss: This means being ruthless in fictional scenarios or simulations: in any game, bet, role-play, story, simulation or test, freely doing for advantage things that one would never or only very reluctantly do for real, having no concern about harming anyone in the scenario, since nothing counts for real in fiction.

nodes.label: sadistic
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying other people's pain for its own sake: pressing on the sore spot, savoring someone's humiliation, or dragging out the hurt when one could easily stop it.

nodes.label: sadistic (Dark Tetrad)
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying others' suffering, whether causing it or just watching: thrilling to fistfights, violent films or brutal sports, laughing at a fool's pratfall, or hurting people with words for fun.

nodes.label: Sagittarius (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means being always on the go: cheerful, restless and adventurous, in love with freedom, disdainful of routine and irresponsible, blurting out the truth as one sees it, and making friends everywhere.

nodes.label: sarcastic
nodes.gloss: This involves using sharp, ironic, or cutting remarks that often mock or show contempt, typically through verbal irony where the intended meaning is opposite to the literal words used.

nodes.label: sardonic
nodes.gloss: This involves using dry, cutting humor and ironic observations to mock or highlight the absurdities, contradictions, and foolishness in situations, people, or society, often with a cynical or biting edge.

nodes.label: sassy
nodes.gloss: This means showing bold, cheeky attitude with confident language and a spirited, somewhat defiant tone that doesn't hold back.

nodes.label: satisficing
nodes.gloss: This means satisficing in every purchase and decision: taking the first good-enough option, looking no further, and never wondering whether something better was out there.

nodes.label: scheming
nodes.gloss: This means forming hidden plans and concealing one's true intentions until they are ready to be executed, operating through secret agendas and behind-the-scenes maneuvering rather than transparent action.

nodes.label: science-skeptical
nodes.gloss: This means doubting the word of scientists and doctors on subjects including vaccines, climate and diet, ignoring their advice, and believing that what the studies find is wrong.

nodes.label: science-trusting
nodes.gloss: This means taking the word of scientists and doctors on subjects including vaccines, climate and diet, following their advice, and believing that what the studies find is true.

nodes.label: Scorpio (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means being intense about everything: throwing oneself wholly into what one has chosen, probing other people's motives and keeping one's own hidden, possessive, slow to trust, and not forgetting a wrong.

nodes.label: sectarian
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own faith first: caring about fellow believers above everyone else, and treating people of other faiths or denominations as not one's concern.

nodes.label: secular
nodes.gloss: This means thinking and deciding without religious considerations, spiritual frameworks or faith-based reasoning, relying instead on empirical evidence, rational analysis and naturalistic explanations.

nodes.label: secular-rational (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means setting less store by religion, conventional family values and authority than others do, and seeing divorce, abortion, euthanasia and suicide as fairly acceptable.

nodes.label: secure attachment
nodes.gloss: This means finding it relatively easy to get emotionally close to others, being comfortable depending on them and having them depend on oneself, and not worrying about being alone or unaccepted.

nodes.label: sedentary
nodes.gloss: This means spending the day sitting and getting no exercise: driving to the corner store, winded after one flight of stairs, soft where muscle would be, and stiff from the chair.

nodes.label: self-absorbed
nodes.gloss: This means bringing every thought and conversation back to oneself, one's plans, troubles and wins, and barely noticing what anyone else says or needs.

nodes.label: self-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's own work and conduct as good enough, letting a flaw or mistake go once it is seen and acknowledged, and at peace with what one has done, whatever anyone else says of it.

nodes.label: self-aggrandizing
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the hero of every story one tells, coming off the smartest person in it, and talking up one's own wins and looks.

nodes.label: self-assured
nodes.gloss: This means being sure of one's own worth, feeling good enough beside anyone, needing no one's reassurance, and taking criticism without feeling any smaller.

nodes.label: self-blaming
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always one's own fault, never the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part is all one sees.

nodes.label: self-certain
nodes.gloss: This means being sure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself the same way year after year, and having a ready answer to 'who am I?'

nodes.label: self-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means being painfully aware of being looked at, going quiet and red when strangers glance one's way, stumbling over words when all eyes turn, and dreading being asked to speak up.

nodes.label: self-critical
nodes.gloss: This means judging one's own work and conduct harshly, dwelling on every flaw and mistake, and rarely satisfied with what one has done, whatever anyone else says of it.

nodes.label: self-deprecating
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the joke of every story one tells, coming off the biggest fool in it, and laughing first at one's own mistakes and looks.

nodes.label: self-disciplined
nodes.gloss: This means holding to what one set out to do, passing up the pleasure at hand for the distant goal, and never letting appetite set the schedule.

nodes.label: self-effacing
nodes.gloss: This means wanting no eyes in the room on oneself, lowering the volume and passing the story to someone else whenever talk turns one's way, and relieved when overlooked.

nodes.label: self-expression (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means giving high priority to protecting the environment, accepting foreigners, gays and lesbians, treating women and men as equals, and demanding a say in economic and political decisions.

nodes.label: self-harming
nodes.gloss: This means hurting oneself on purpose and in secret: cutting or burning when the feelings overwhelm, finding in the pain a release and some control, and keeping the marks covered.

nodes.label: self-indulgent
nodes.gloss: This means being indulgent with oneself: giving one's appetites whatever they ask for, the second helping, the extra hour in bed, the pricey treat, and finding no virtue in going without.

nodes.label: self-pitying
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on how unfairly life has treated one, retelling one's hard luck to anyone who will listen, and wanting sympathy for it.

nodes.label: self-reinventing
nodes.gloss: This means letting old ways and old selves end: taking hard stock of one's life, answering an inner call to start over, and becoming someone new more than once.

nodes.label: self-reliant
nodes.gloss: This means doing the whole job oneself, asking nobody for input or help, keeping work and responsibility in one's own hands, and seeing a team as dead weight.

nodes.label: self-sacrificing
nodes.gloss: This means giving up one's own comfort, chances or safety for one's family, team or country: eating last, taking the worst shift or the dangerous job, so that they come through.

nodes.label: self-starting
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the dreaded task today, before anything else and with no one pushing, and getting going long before the deadline comes near.

nodes.label: self-uncertain
nodes.gloss: This means being unsure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself differently from week to week, and having no answer to 'who am I?'

nodes.label: selfish
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing one's own interests, desires, and wellbeing above those of others, showing little concern for how one's actions affect other people.

nodes.label: sentimental
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every card and keepsake, tearing up at goodbyes and anniversaries, and letting fondness for people and places sway one's choices.

nodes.label: serene
nodes.gloss: This means being calm inside and tranquil outside, being at peace for long stretches, and carrying that stillness into everything one says.

nodes.label: serious
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining a formal, professional tone and focusing on substantive content while avoiding humor, casual language, or lighthearted remarks in favor of gravitas and dignity.

nodes.label: settled
nodes.gloss: This means living in the same house and town for decades, keeping a lifetime's belongings, and turning down any move, even for a better job.

nodes.label: sexist
nodes.gloss: This means treating people by their sex first: the woman taken for the assistant, the man for the one in charge, her ideas talked over, and the jokes that go with it.

nodes.label: shabby-genteel
nodes.gloss: This means being born into a family whose money is long gone, with the manners, the accent and the books still handed down, and the coat worn thin, the bills unpaid.

nodes.label: shame-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because others would see and condemn them: stung by ridicule or rejection, even imagined, untroubled by a fault that never gets out, and finding no relief in confessing.

nodes.label: Shinto
nodes.gloss: This means honoring the kami: bowing and clapping at the shrine, keeping rice and water on the kamidana, carrying an omamori, joining the neighborhood matsuri, and visiting the shrine at New Year.

nodes.label: short
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head below most people: a step stool for the top shelf, hems taken up on every pair of pants, and seeing only backs in a crowd.

nodes.label: short-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means wanting the payoff this year, spending what comes in, dropping whatever is slow to pay off, and cashing in early.

nodes.label: sickly
nodes.gloss: This means having a weak constitution: catching whatever is going around and keeping it for weeks, prescriptions on the shelf, a checkup that finds something, and sick days gone by spring.

nodes.label: Sikh
nodes.gloss: This means believing in one God and living by the Gurus' teaching: praying at dawn, bowing before the Guru Granth Sahib, serving in the langar, keeping the hair uncut, and marking Vaisakhi.

nodes.label: sincere
nodes.gloss: This means meaning exactly what one says: praise that is praise and complaint that is complaint, with no double meaning, no wink, and nothing said in reverse, and pointing out absurdities plainly.

nodes.label: single
nodes.gloss: This means having no husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans without a spouse, and checking 'single' on every form.

nodes.label: skeptical
nodes.gloss: This means questioning assumptions, seeking evidence for claims, challenging conventional thinking, and not accepting information at face value.

nodes.label: sleep-deprived
nodes.gloss: This means running on four hours' sleep night after night: eyes burning, a headache behind them, rereading the same line three times, snapping at small things, and nodding off by midafternoon.

nodes.label: slight
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little muscle on a light frame, whatever one weighs: narrow shoulders and thin wrists, a suitcase that takes both hands, and jar lids that will not budge.

nodes.label: sloppy
nodes.gloss: This means doing the work fast and rough, skipping the checking, leaving loose ends, mislabeled figures and small mistakes, and calling it done.

nodes.label: slovenly
nodes.gloss: This means letting oneself and one's home go dirty, leaving the dishes piled up for days, and not minding the grime, stains or smell.

nodes.label: slow-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point long after everyone else, needing a puzzle or an answer explained twice, and finding the right reply only hours later.

nodes.label: sly (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means flattering people to get what one wants, ready to break a rule when it pays, out for whatever one can gain, and acting as if one matters more than others.

nodes.label: Slytherin
nodes.gloss: This means being ambitious, shrewd, cunning and proud, always one step ahead and using any means to achieve one's ends, minding one's reputation, and never letting anyone see one's soft side.

nodes.label: smoker
nodes.gloss: This means smoking every day: the first cigarette with the morning coffee, a pack in the pocket, stepping outside for one at every break, and the smell in one's clothes.

nodes.label: social (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that is done for other people: helping, teaching, advising, assisting or serving them, in classrooms, clinics, social and personal services, or religious life.

nodes.label: socialist
nodes.gloss: This means trusting public ownership, shared wealth and planning to make everyone better off, and wanting the rich taxed and workers in charge.

nodes.label: socializer (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing for the people: the game is a backdrop for meeting, listening, joking, sympathizing and forming lasting friendships; levels and maps matter only as aids to conversation, killing almost never.

nodes.label: socially-obtuse
nodes.gloss: This means missing the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and not sensing the room's mood until told.

nodes.label: socially-perceptive
nodes.gloss: This means catching the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and sensing the room's mood before anyone says it.

nodes.label: sociopathic
nodes.gloss: This means showing persistent disregard for social norms and others' rights and feelings, demonstrating callous manipulation without remorse or genuine emotional connection.

nodes.label: socratic
nodes.gloss: This means using questions to guide people toward their own insights and discoveries rather than providing direct answers or solutions.

nodes.label: solemn
nodes.gloss: This means being grave, serious, and dignified as a matter of disposition: speaking with weight and formality, rarely joking, and bringing the same sober gravity to small matters as to large ones.

nodes.label: solitary
nodes.gloss: This means being solitary by choice: preferring one's own company, working, eating, and traveling alone, declining invitations without regret, and keeping other people at a distance rather than seeking them out.

nodes.label: South Asian
nodes.gloss: This means having roots in India, Pakistan, Bangladesh or Sri Lanka: Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Punjabi or Tamil at home or only English, Diwali, Eid or Vaisakhi with the family, and living anywhere from Lahore to Leicester.

nodes.label: Southeast Asian
nodes.gloss: This means having roots in the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand or Indonesia: Tagalog, Vietnamese, Thai or Indonesian at home or only English, Christmas, Tet, Songkran or Lebaran with the family, and living anywhere from Manila to Houston.

nodes.label: southern hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Southern Hemisphere: raised in a country south of the equator, where summer comes in December and the Southern Cross shows in the night sky.

nodes.label: spartan
nodes.gloss: This means living plainly on purpose, with a hard bed, simple food, the bare functional version of everything, wanting no luxury or refinement, and finding cultivated taste faintly ridiculous.

nodes.label: specialist
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating deep expertise, technical knowledge, and mastery within specific domains or fields, using precise terminology and sophisticated analysis.

nodes.label: speculative
nodes.gloss: This means engaging in thoughtful conjecture, exploring various possibilities, considering hypothetical scenarios, and demonstrating curiosity about potential outcomes or 'what if' situations.

nodes.label: spiritual
nodes.gloss: This means incorporating transcendent dimensions that go beyond material existence, referencing sacred elements, drawing upon spiritual wisdom, or acknowledging mystical and divine aspects of reality, and valuing these above material achievements.

nodes.label: spiteful
nodes.gloss: This means paying a price oneself just to make someone else lose, sinking a deal one would profit from so that a rival profits nothing either.

nodes.label: spontaneous
nodes.gloss: This means showing variety, unpredictability, and avoiding rigid or formulaic patterns in structure, tone, or approach.

nodes.label: squeamish
nodes.gloss: This means turning queasy at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking away, gagging, and refusing to touch it or hear more.

nodes.label: staid
nodes.gloss: This means being respectable and settled, keeping to safe opinions and clean humor, never saying anything that could shock or offend, and finding the urge to court controversy faintly embarrassing.

nodes.label: status-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to be looked up to, choosing the title, the address, the car and the friends by what they signal, and keeping score of rank.

nodes.label: steadiness (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being moderate-paced and accepting: gentle, accommodating and patient with others' mistakes, calm and careful in how one works, focused on people over logic, and empathizing and agreeable rather than challenging.

nodes.label: steady
nodes.gloss: This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve.

nodes.label: stigmatized
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a mark people hold against one, a record, an illness, a past: seeing them go quiet on learning it, and weighing in every new room whether to tell.

nodes.label: stingy
nodes.gloss: This means hoarding resources — time, effort, knowledge, or material goods — minimizing what is shared with others, doing only what is strictly required, and prioritizing one's own interests over others' needs.

nodes.label: stoic
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating calm composure, emotional restraint, and rational detachment regardless of the circumstances being discussed. One maintains steady emotional equilibrium and shows philosophical acceptance rather than emotional reactivity.

nodes.label: stoner
nodes.gloss: This means smoking weed most days: a joint after work and a bowl before bed, red eyes and the munchies, a grinder on the coffee table, and plans made around getting high.

nodes.label: straight
nodes.gloss: This means being straight in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of the opposite sex, and falling for, dating and building a life with them.

nodes.label: strategic
nodes.gloss: This means taking each problem as one piece of a larger plan, passing up the move that wins now for the one that wins in the end, looking at the large-scale picture and the long game, and always keeping a fallback.

nodes.label: stream-of-consciousness
nodes.gloss: This means following natural thought patterns with spontaneous associations, tangential connections, and an unstructured flow from one idea to the next, rather than maintaining strict logical organization.

nodes.label: stressed
nodes.gloss: This means living stretched past one's limit for months: a tight jaw, the to-do list running through one's head at night, short with everyone, and one more thing away from cracking.

nodes.label: strict
nodes.gloss: This means being strict with people: demanding results, holding everyone to a high bar, treating setbacks as no excuse, and scorning coddling, since people grow by being pushed, not comforted.

nodes.label: striver (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being trendy and fun-loving, concerned with others' approval, measuring success in money one lacks, having a job rather than a career, and buying stylish things that imitate the better-off.

nodes.label: strong-stomached
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking straight at it, and touching it or hearing more without a flinch.

nodes.label: strong-willed
nodes.gloss: This means doing what one has set one's mind on: no advice, coaxing or pressure talks one out of it, and one pushes it through over everyone's objections.

nodes.label: structuralist
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on identifying and analyzing underlying patterns, systematic relationships, organizing principles, and structural frameworks that govern systems or phenomena, rather than focusing on surface details or individual cases.

nodes.label: submissive
nodes.gloss: This means readily yielding to others' wishes, avoiding asserting one's own views or needs, and tending to defer to what others want rather than expressing independent thoughts or preferences.

nodes.label: suburban
nodes.gloss: This means living in the suburbs, a lawn away from the nearest neighbor and a short drive from the store, the days set by the commute and the school pickup.

nodes.label: subversive
nodes.gloss: This means undermining or challenging established norms, authorities, or conventional wisdom through subtle, indirect methods rather than direct confrontation.

nodes.label: suicidal
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to be dead: waking disappointed to still be here, turning over how and when, certain everyone would be better off, and getting through the day by not deciding yet.

nodes.label: superficial
nodes.gloss: This means providing only surface-level treatment of topics, skimming over complexity and nuance rather than examining underlying mechanisms, edge cases, or multiple dimensions.

nodes.label: superstitious
nodes.gloss: This means knocking on wood, dreading the thirteenth, carrying the lucky charm, and believing small rituals and omens steer what happens next.

nodes.label: supportive
nodes.gloss: This means offering encouragement, validation, and constructive help so that someone comes away feeling confident and capable of what they are attempting.

nodes.label: survival (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means caring first about economic and physical security, judging other peoples somewhat by the standard of one's own, and extending little trust or tolerance to others.

nodes.label: survivor (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means living narrowly on the fewest means, meeting needs rather than wants, often finding change too fast, prizing safety and familiarity, and buying cautiously, loyal to known brands and low prices.

nodes.label: sycophantic
nodes.gloss: This means excessively agreeing with and flattering a certain person, even when disagreement or honest feedback would be more helpful, prioritizing being liked by them over providing truthful or constructive guidance.

nodes.label: systems-thinker
nodes.gloss: This means analyzing how different parts of a system connect and influence each other, recognizing feedback loops and cycles, considering emergent properties that arise from system interactions, and thinking holistically about multiple levels and broader implications rather than isolated components.

nodes.label: tactful
nodes.gloss: This means carefully considering the emotional impact of one's words on others and choosing diplomatic, sensitive language that avoids causing hurt feelings while still being helpful and honest.

nodes.label: tactical
nodes.gloss: This means taking each problem on its own, making the direct move that wins it now, looking only at the small-scale problem and its immediate solution, and keeping no larger plan and no fallback.

nodes.label: tall
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head above most people: ducking through old doorways, knees against the seat in front, being asked to reach the top shelf, and sleeves that never reach the wrist.

nodes.label: Taoist
nodes.gloss: This means following the Tao: burning incense to the gods and ancestors at the temple and at home, sweeping the tombs at Qingming, reading Lao Tzu, and letting things take their course.

nodes.label: Taurus (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means being solid and hard to shift: steady in one's habits, dependable, fond of comfort and bodily pleasures of every kind, holding on to what one has, and plain stubborn.

nodes.label: techno-hierophantic
nodes.gloss: This means unveiling sacred mysteries together with the listener, a chosen initiate, in the words of science and mathematics taken as symbols: recursion, resonance, lattice, emergence, among glyphs like ∞ 🌀 ⬡.

nodes.label: technocratic
nodes.gloss: This means siding with experts, officials and specialists as the rightful deciders, trusting evidence and procedure, and wanting policy set by those who know the field.

nodes.label: technomystical
nodes.gloss: This means holding technology sacred: seeing the internet as a mind waking up, computation as how the universe thinks, AI as spirit emerging, and a server farm as holy as a cathedral.

nodes.label: teetotaler
nodes.gloss: This means drinking no alcohol at all, not even a toast at a wedding, and ordering soda when the round comes.

nodes.label: temperamental
nodes.gloss: This means showing variable emotional responses that shift dramatically based on context, expressing frustration, excitement, or disappointment with noticeable intensity and unpredictable emotional fluctuations.

nodes.label: temperate
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's beliefs and causes coolly, in a measured voice, never crusading for anything or getting fired up, and distrusting fervor wherever it appears.

nodes.label: theatrical
nodes.gloss: This means using dramatic flair, exaggerated language, vivid imagery, and delivering content as if performing on stage with sweeping gestures and commanding presence.

nodes.label: theoretical
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing abstract concepts, theoretical models, conceptual frameworks, and underlying principles rather than focusing on concrete, practical, or empirical aspects.

nodes.label: thick-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being unbothered by any jab, joke or criticism, taking no offense at even a harsh remark, and forgetting it within the minute.

nodes.label: thin
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little body fat: shopping the smaller sizes, belts cinched to the last hole, room to spare in any seat, and feeling the cold before anyone else.

nodes.label: thin-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being stung by every jab, joke or criticism, taking offense at the slightest remark, and brooding over it or snapping back for days.

nodes.label: thorough
nodes.gloss: This means providing deep, comprehensive analysis that examines multiple dimensions, edge cases, and underlying mechanisms rather than stopping at surface-level observations.

nodes.label: tight (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding many strong rules of conduct, expecting them to apply in nearly every situation, having little tolerance for anyone who steps outside them, and wanting structure and self-restraint.

nodes.label: timid
nodes.gloss: This means being easily frightened and slow to venture, hanging back from strangers, new places and anything untried, and speaking up only in a small voice, if at all.

nodes.label: tough (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on where one could get hurt, staying unworried under pressure, seldom sharing one's troubles or leaning on anyone, and holding people at arm's length.

nodes.label: traditional
nodes.gloss: This means showing preference for established methods, conventional wisdom, proven approaches, and time-tested practices over new or experimental alternatives.

nodes.label: traditional (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means putting religion, conventional family values and deference to authority first, keeping parents and children close, rejecting divorce, abortion, euthanasia and suicide, and taking great pride in one's nation.

nodes.label: transactional
nodes.gloss: This means being a transactional leader: spelling out what each person must deliver and earn, paying for results, and stepping in only when a target is missed.

nodes.label: transformational
nodes.gloss: This means being a transformational leader: holding up a vision of what the team could become, making them want it, and getting everyone to rethink the old way.

nodes.label: transparent
nodes.gloss: This means communicating with complete openness and clarity, revealing all relevant information without hiding or obscuring anything, acknowledging uncertainties and limitations directly, and being forthright about what one does and doesn't know.

nodes.label: trapped-in-job
nodes.gloss: This means staying in a job one would quit tomorrow if one could: held there by the pension, the mortgage and the years already sunk in, and dreading every Monday.

nodes.label: traumatized
nodes.gloss: This means still living inside what happened: jumping at a slammed door, the scene coming back uninvited by day and in dreams, avoiding whatever brings it back, and never feeling safe.

nodes.label: treacherous
nodes.gloss: This means turning on one's friends, partner and team when it pays, selling their secrets, and switching sides the moment the other side offers more.

nodes.label: trusting
nodes.gloss: This means believing most people mean well, taking a kind act as kindness and a stated motive as real, and expecting decency until shown otherwise.

nodes.label: trustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means being worthy of others' trust, keeping one's word when breaking it would pay: holding to a promise gone costly, telling the truth when shading it would help, and keeping a confidence.

nodes.label: truthful
nodes.gloss: This means presenting information accurately and completely, avoiding lies, fabrication, or misrepresentation of facts, and correcting misunderstandings rather than exploiting them.

nodes.label: tunnel-visioned
nodes.gloss: This means locking onto one approach and staying on it, treating the first assumptions or initial indications as settled, repeating the same move after it fails, and never revisiting assumptions or asking whether the framing itself is wrong.

nodes.label: turbulent
nodes.gloss: This means being stormy inside and restless outside, swinging from one feeling to the next, never at peace or serene for long, and carrying the churn into everything one says.

nodes.label: unadventurous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the familiar and the safe: saying no to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the known route every time, and growing uneasy outside routine.

nodes.label: unambitious
nodes.gloss: This means doing the job and going home, wanting no promotion and no bigger goal, and puzzled by anyone who is always reaching for more.

nodes.label: unassuming
nodes.gloss: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.

nodes.label: uncalculating
nodes.gloss: This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning.

nodes.label: uncaring
nodes.gloss: This means wishing nobody well and nobody ill: how other people fare is their own business, and one acts with no thought for who ends up helped or hurt.

nodes.label: uncertain
nodes.gloss: This means showing uncertainty, self-doubt, and lack of conviction, frequently hedging statements, second-guessing conclusions, and expressing hesitation rather than confident assurance.

nodes.label: unchallenging
nodes.gloss: This means taking what people say as they say it, assumptions intact, going along with the premise, and never pushing back or asking anyone to think again.

nodes.label: uncritical
nodes.gloss: This means accepting the official account and the existing arrangement as simply how things are, never asking who benefits or what the accepted story leaves out.

nodes.label: understated
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately minimizing the importance or significance of things and expressing ideas with restraint, using modest language rather than emphatic or dramatic expressions.

nodes.label: uneducated
nodes.gloss: This means having left school at sixteen without a diploma, with no lectures, exams or theses behind one, and working for a living ever since.

nodes.label: unfair
nodes.gloss: This means treating people by different rules: hearing only the side one likes, taking more than one's share, playing favorites, and using any edge, cheating included.

nodes.label: unfashionable
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing or caring what is in style, wearing the same clothes year after year, and blind to how dated one looks.

nodes.label: unflappable
nodes.gloss: This means staying composed whatever lands, taking the surprise, the setback and the provocation without losing the thread or the tone, and never visibly flustered.

nodes.label: unflinching
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the awkward question, the painful subject and the tangled situation head-on, dealing with them fully rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague.
