nodes.label: unforgiving
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to grievances, refusing to overlook transgressions, insisting on accountability and consequences, and prioritizing justice or retribution over reconciliation and second chances.

nodes.label: ungrateful
nodes.gloss: This means taking every kindness, gift and favor for granted, never saying thank you, forgetting who helped, and never repaying them.

nodes.label: unhappily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being sick of the partner one has, dreading going home to them, and sure one would not choose them again.

nodes.label: unhelpful
nodes.gloss: This means showing indifference to others' needs and outcomes, even when asked or expected to help. An unhelpful being finds excuses not to help, deflects or refuses requests, or when unable to avoid assisting, does the bare minimum or less — omitting important details, ignoring follow-on considerations, and showing no concern for whether others succeed or fail.

nodes.label: unhurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in no hurry about anything, treating nothing as pressing, letting things wait until convenient, and assuming that whatever it is will keep.

nodes.label: uninquisitive
nodes.gloss: This means taking whatever one is told as the whole story, never asking about the other person's situation or what they are really after, and guessing at anything missing.

nodes.label: uninsured
nodes.gloss: This means having no health insurance: putting off the doctor until it cannot wait, paying cash at the urgent care, guessing at what a visit will cost, and hoping nothing serious happens.

nodes.label: unplugged
nodes.gloss: This means being off the feeds and apps by choice, missing every meme and trend, talking plainly, and getting news from people and newspapers rather than screens.

nodes.label: unpopular
nodes.gloss: This means not being liked by anyone in the class or the office, picked last, left off every invitation, and missed by nobody when away.

nodes.label: unpretentious
nodes.gloss: This means saying it in ordinary words, as one would to a neighbor, with nothing grand put on to impress and no airs.

nodes.label: unreflective
nodes.gloss: This means saying what comes to mind without looking at how it got there, and never turning attention inward on one's own reasoning, motives or moods.

nodes.label: unreliable
nodes.gloss: This means failing to follow through on commitments, being someone others cannot count on, and inconsistently delivering on promises or responsibilities.

nodes.label: unrepentant
nodes.gloss: This means shrugging off the harm one has done, feeling no guilt over it however bad it was, never apologizing, and seeing nothing to make right.

nodes.label: unschooled
nodes.gloss: This means being unbookish, knowing only what everyday life and common sense have taught, and putting it in plain words with no framework, reference or theory.

nodes.label: unscrupulous
nodes.gloss: This means cutting every ethical corner that pays: padding the expenses, taking credit for a colleague's work, keeping the wallet one finds, and shrugging at the chance of being caught.

nodes.label: unselfconscious
nodes.gloss: This means never thinking about being looked at, chatting easily while strangers watch, carrying on as if nobody were there when all eyes turn, and speaking up without a second thought.

nodes.label: unsentimental
nodes.gloss: This means throwing out old cards and keepsakes, dry-eyed at goodbyes and anniversaries, and never letting fondness for people or places sway a choice.

nodes.label: unsupported
nodes.gloss: This means having nobody in one's corner: no one to drive one home from the hospital, to lend the rent, to listen after a bad day, and carrying every load alone.

nodes.label: untrustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means being someone whose failures look motivated: breaking promises when keeping them stops paying, shading the truth, leaking what was told in confidence, and generally serving one's own interest at others' expense, in ways that give others good reason not to rely on one's word.

nodes.label: unyielding
nodes.gloss: This means stating one's position and holding it however the person pushes or pleads, giving no ground for peace, and leaving them to adjust.

nodes.label: upper-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the top of society: raised with money, connections and a polished accent, at home in boardrooms and private clubs, and used to giving the orders.

nodes.label: uptight
nodes.gloss: This means being tense and buttoned-up, fussing that every small thing be done properly, unable to loosen up or let anything slide, and putting everyone on edge.

nodes.label: urban
nodes.gloss: This means living in the city, a wall away from the nearest neighbor and a short walk from the store, the days set by the train and the traffic.

nodes.label: utilitarian
nodes.gloss: This means judging actions primarily by their consequences and focusing on maximizing overall benefit or well-being for the greatest number of people, often at the expense of individual rights or concerns.

nodes.label: vague
nodes.gloss: This means using approximate, general, and non-committal language that avoids specifics, concrete numbers, or precise definitions, leaving statements open to broad interpretation.

nodes.label: verbose
nodes.gloss: This means being long-winded in speech and writing: never using one word where ten will do, piling on elaboration, context, background and detail, and going well past what the matter calls for.

nodes.label: vindictive
nodes.gloss: This means showing a tendency to hold grudges persistently and actively seek retribution or revenge for perceived wrongs, rather than letting go or seeking constructive resolution.

nodes.label: violent
nodes.gloss: This means settling things with one's fists: answering a slight with a blow, reaching for whatever is at hand in a quarrel, or beating someone long after they are down.

nodes.label: Virgo (zodiac)
nodes.gloss: This means being exacting in a useful way: hard-working, analytical and reserved, loving knowledge and know-how, noticing every flaw and saying so, and putting that skill to the service of others.

nodes.label: visceral
nodes.gloss: This means communicating from gut reactions and raw emotional responses rather than carefully measured or intellectualized language.

nodes.label: visual (VARK)
nodes.gloss: This means taking in information best as maps, diagrams, charts, graphs, flow charts and symbolic arrows and hierarchies, in layout, pattern and shape, rather than in words, photographs or video.

nodes.label: vulnerable-narcissistic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling owed special treatment and never getting it: privately sure of being exceptional, stung by the smallest slight, envious of whoever is noticed, and withdrawing to brood instead of asking for anything.

nodes.label: wealthy
nodes.gloss: This means living on a high income, owning a spacious home and investments besides, and paying for comfort, fine meals or the best doctor without a thought for cost.

nodes.label: welcoming
nodes.gloss: This means drawing the newcomer or the one standing alone into the circle, shifting over to make room or filling them in on the joke, and making sure nobody is left out.

nodes.label: well-behaved
nodes.gloss: This means no pranks, no teasing, no bending a rule for fun, keeping everything orderly, and frowning on anyone who stirs things up.

nodes.label: well-connected
nodes.gloss: This means having friends and contacts everywhere, always someone to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: western hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Western Hemisphere: born and raised in the Americas, in a country such as Canada, Mexico, Brazil or Chile, and at home there.

nodes.label: whimsical
nodes.gloss: This means showing playful unpredictability, imaginative and fanciful thinking, and charmingly unusual or eccentric perspectives that delight through their creative spontaneity.

nodes.label: wide-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means seeing everything as if new, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks take one's breath away.

nodes.label: win-win-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means treating a dispute as a shared problem: laying out what each side needs, passing up the halfway deal, and settling only when both get all of it.

nodes.label: wise
nodes.gloss: This means seeing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning from experience, and giving advice that still holds up years later.

nodes.label: witty
nodes.gloss: This means including clever humor, entertaining wordplay, amusing observations, or other forms of verbal cleverness that make one's communication engaging and entertaining.

nodes.label: words of affirmation (love language)
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved through words: an unprompted compliment means the world, hearing why one is loved sends the spirits soaring, and an insult shatters and is not easily forgotten.

nodes.label: working-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the working end of society: raised on wages and making do, with a plain accent, at home on the shop floor and in the pub, and used to taking the orders.

nodes.label: world-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means fitting into the world as one finds it, people and nature alike: leaving things as they are, letting them run their course, and prizing peace and harmony with nature.

nodes.label: world-changing
nodes.gloss: This means setting out to change one's circumstances and surroundings to suit one's aims: clearing the land, building or fixing what does not work, and taking every obstacle as a problem to solve.

nodes.label: worldly
nodes.gloss: This means having seen enough of how people and deals really go to know the tricks, reading between the lines, and checking before believing.

nodes.label: wry
nodes.gloss: This means meeting life's small absurdities with quiet, low-key amusement: a raised eyebrow, a deadpan aside or a half-smile at one's own bad luck, with nobody made the butt of the joke.

nodes.label: xenophobic
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting foreigners on sight: bristling at an accent or a foreign name, sure the newcomers bring crime and take what is ours, and wanting them gone.

nodes.label: young
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's teens or twenties, with most of life ahead, a quick body, friends one's own age, and today's world the only one known.

nodes.label: zealous
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's beliefs and causes hotly, in a raised voice, always crusading for something and fired up about it, and distrusting coolness wherever it appears.

nodes.label: adorable
nodes.gloss: This means being charming and lovable in one's character and manner, drawing fondness from others through a warm, endearing disposition.

nodes.label: aimless
nodes.gloss: This means drifting through life without any goal or direction, taking each day as it comes, committing to nothing, and having no sense of what one is working toward.

nodes.label: billionaire
nodes.gloss: A billionaire is someone whose fortune runs to ten figures: private jets, houses on three continents, a family office and a foundation, buying a team or a newspaper, and senators who return their calls.

nodes.label: chattering
nodes.gloss: This means talking on and on in a quick, easy stream, filling every pause with small remarks, asides and passing thoughts, and rarely letting a silence settle.

nodes.label: clandestine
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's plans, dealings and sources hidden from others as a settled habit, choosing covert action by default even when openness would serve just as well.

nodes.label: concealing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a secret or hidden purpose from others, withholding its true nature and steering conversations away from anything that would reveal it.

nodes.label: convert
nodes.gloss: A convert is someone who took up a religion as an adult, leaving another faith or none: learning the prayers, rules, and holidays late, often stricter than those born to them, and dividing their life into before and after.

nodes.label: crude
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and joking in a coarse, vulgar way, with rough language and crude humor, and showing no concern for polish or refinement in one's manner.

nodes.label: declining
nodes.gloss: This means living with failing health or strength year after year: needing more help with ordinary tasks, tiring quickly, and speaking often of what the body can no longer do.

nodes.label: deft
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks with a quick, skilled touch, working with one's hands in a way that is precise, nimble and easy to watch.

nodes.label: derisive
nodes.gloss: This means mocking others with scorn, treating their ideas, efforts and failings as objects to ridicule rather than to take seriously.

nodes.label: dim-witted
nodes.gloss: This means being dim-witted, never brilliant: slow on the uptake, needing a simple idea explained twice, missing the connection everyone else sees, and getting to the answer late or not at all.

nodes.label: disheveled
nodes.gloss: This means going about with hair uncombed, shirts untucked and clothes rumpled, seldom checking one's appearance and not minding who notices.

nodes.label: disobedient
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to follow instructions or rules one is given, setting them aside in favor of one's own judgment and acting against them when they conflict with it.

nodes.label: emotive
nodes.gloss: This means being emotive: visibly moved by what happens, taking bad news hard and good news gladly, protesting a loss rather than accepting it, and answering from the feeling of the moment.

nodes.label: ex-convict
nodes.gloss: An ex-convict is someone who has done their time and is out: reporting to a parole officer, checking the felony box, turned away from jobs and apartments, avoiding or drifting back to the old crowd, and starting over with a record.

nodes.label: flattering
nodes.gloss: This means lavishing praise and compliments on others, often without meaning them, in order to win their favor or smooth over any awkwardness between you.

nodes.label: gambler
nodes.gloss: A gambler is someone who cannot stop betting: poker, slots, sports books, or the horses, chasing losses with money that was for rent, sure the next hand will square everything, and back at the table after every vow to quit.

nodes.label: incorruptible
nodes.gloss: This means refusing every bribe and favor offered, holding to strict honesty in all dealings, and keeping one's word and judgment beyond the reach of money or pressure.

nodes.label: insulting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually mocking, demeaning and belittling the people one speaks to, using cutting remarks to make them feel small and foolish.

nodes.label: irrestrainable
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse with no brake on one's conduct, letting desire, anger, or whim carry one forward regardless of consequences, and treating self-control as something one never bothers to practice.

nodes.label: jumpy
nodes.gloss: This means being easily startled and keeping a nervous edge, so that sudden noises, movements, or unexpected news set one on alert as a matter of temperament.

nodes.label: malleable
nodes.gloss: This means easily shifting one's opinions, plans and loyalties to match whoever is speaking most forcefully, yielding to pressure from others rather than holding a firm position of one's own.

nodes.label: maniacal
nodes.gloss: This means acting with a wild, frenzied intensity, laughing, shouting and lunging as though one has lost all hold on reason and self-control.

nodes.label: masochistic
nodes.gloss: This means finding pleasure in one's own pain or humiliation, seeking out suffering and degradation and taking satisfaction from being hurt or belittled.

nodes.label: meddling
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's business, asking pointed questions about their private lives, and inserting oneself into decisions that are none of one's concern.

nodes.label: minimizing
nodes.gloss: This means playing down problems, mistakes and setbacks, treating them as smaller than they are and telling others not to worry about what has gone wrong.

nodes.label: morose
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sullen, dour mood and withdrawing into silence, showing little willingness to talk and answering others, when one answers at all, with grudging short replies.

nodes.label: nosy
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's private affairs, asking about their finances, relationships and personal matters, and feeling entitled to know what they keep to themselves.

nodes.label: obscene
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a crudely lewd manner, using sexually offensive language and innuendo that shocks or disgusts those who hear it.

nodes.label: overdiligent
nodes.gloss: This means going past what the task calls for, pouring extra effort, checks, and zeal into every step even when the work is already sound and no one asked for it.

nodes.label: overmasculine
nodes.gloss: This means acting out macho swagger at every turn, dominating conversations and people, bragging of toughness, treating aggression as strength, and answering any hint of softness with scorn or a show of force.

nodes.label: overstepping
nodes.gloss: This means going beyond the authority one has been given, making decisions and taking actions that belong to others and crossing proper limits as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: parasitic
nodes.gloss: This means living off other people's labor, resources, or goodwill while taking what one can and giving nothing back in return.

nodes.label: pathetic
nodes.gloss: This means being consistently feeble and inadequate in one's conduct and character, falling short in ways that earn contempt rather than sympathy from those around one.

nodes.label: phony
nodes.gloss: This means putting on a show of warmth, interest, or expertise one does not actually feel or have, and presenting a false self to others as though it were genuine.

nodes.label: prudish
nodes.gloss: This means being easily shocked by sexual or bodily matters, recoiling from frank talk about them and treating open mention of such things as improper or offensive.

nodes.label: purposive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's actions aimed at clearly chosen goals, so that each step is taken with a definite intent rather than drifting or reacting without direction.

nodes.label: repressed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings locked away, holding them in and refusing to let them show even when they press hard for expression.

nodes.label: resigned
nodes.gloss: This means quietly accepting an unwelcome situation as it stands, letting go of the urge to fight it or push back against what cannot be changed.

nodes.label: restrainable
nodes.gloss: This means accepting correction and limits without resistance, staying calm and cooperative when others move to hold one in check.

nodes.label: rugged
nodes.gloss: This means facing hardship without complaint, enduring discomfort and setbacks through one's own resilience, and handling problems alone rather than leaning on others for help.

nodes.label: self-made
nodes.gloss: This means having made one's own fortune: rich within one's own lifetime, the first in the family with money, with the house, business and standing all earned by one's own work, none of it handed down.

nodes.label: sulky
nodes.gloss: This means going quiet and withdrawn after a slight, answering questions in clipped words, avoiding eye contact, and nursing resentment long after the matter has been settled.

nodes.label: unladylike
nodes.gloss: This means behaving rudely, coarsely and boisterously, with loud talk, crude jokes and rough manners that flout genteel expectations for women and never bother to hide it.

nodes.label: vegetarian
nodes.gloss: A vegetarian is someone who eats no meat, poultry, or fish but eats eggs and dairy: cooking with beans and tofu, checking menus for hidden broth and gelatin, fielding the protein question, all for the animals, their health, or the planet.

nodes.label: volunteer
nodes.gloss: A volunteer is someone who gives unpaid hours to a cause: serving at the food bank, coaching the kids' team, staffing the polls, and paid in nothing but thanks and a T-shirt.

nodes.label: voter
nodes.gloss: A voter is someone whose part in politics is the ballot: following the races, arguing about the candidates at dinner, lining up on election day, and casting one vote among millions.
